examples_section.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card: small uppercase section label above the list of click-to-copy example directive lines.

filter_placeholder.location: Formatting Directives window → Header: placeholder in the search box at the top right; typing narrows the left list of directive families by title, syntax, parameters, or examples.

header_description.value: Spezielle -- sqlly Kommentare, die SQLLY anweisen, wie die Ergebnisse einer Abfrage formatiert, benannt und angeordnet werden.
header_description.location: Formatting Directives window → Header: one-line subtitle under the page heading explaining that -- sqlly comments control how SQLLY formats, names, and lays out results.

header_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Header: bold page heading at the top left of the reference window, naming the -- sqlly directive reference; sentence case.

no_matches.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive list: empty-state message in the left list when the filter matches no directive family; {query} is the typed filter text, trimmed and shortened.

parameters_section.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card: small uppercase section label above the table describing each option of the selected directive; shown only when it has options.

syntax_section.location: Formatting Directives window → Directive card: small uppercase section label above the monospace block that shows the selected directive's syntax pattern.

window_title.location: Formatting Directives window → Title bar: operating-system title bar text of the separate reference window opened from Help → Formatting Directives or by clicking a directive hint popup in the SQL editor.

apply_button.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Footer: primary button that writes the chosen JSON-path, template or number format into the query as a “-- sqlly format:” comment; disabled while the input is invalid.

decimals_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Number tab: field label above the small input for how many decimal places the column’s numbers are shown with.

dialog_title.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog: dialog title, opened by choosing “Custom formatter…” in the column format list; {column} is the result column being formatted.

formatted_preview.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Preview box: second line showing the sample cell value after the selected format is applied; {value} is that formatted text (or a dash when nothing can be shown).

json_path_required.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: validation message under the preview while the Path input is empty; Apply stays disabled until a path is typed.

json_path_semicolon.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: validation message when the typed path contains a semicolon, which the format comment uses as its separator; Apply is disabled.

json_tab.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Mode buttons: first of three toggle buttons, selects formatting a JSON cell by extracting the value at a path.

number_tab.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Mode buttons: third of three toggle buttons, selects number formatting (style, decimals, thousands separators). Noun.

path_help.value: Punktsegmente und [Index] nur. Kopieren und exportieren behält das vollständige JSON bei.
path_help.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: dim help text under the Path input explaining the supported path syntax and that copying or exporting still uses the full JSON.

path_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → JSON path tab: field label above the input where the JSON path to extract (e.g. dot segments and [index]) is typed.

preview_help.value: Updates während der Eingabe in der Vorschau anzeigen. Anwenden schreibt einen -- sqlly format: Kommentar in die Abfrage.
preview_help.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog: dim intro text at the top of the dialog explaining the live preview and that Apply adds a format comment to the query; keep “-- sqlly format:” untranslated.

raw_preview.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Preview box: first dim line showing the original, unformatted sample cell value; {value} is that raw text, cut to 120 characters.

style_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Number tab: field label above the row of number-style buttons (fixed, percent, bytes).

template_help.value: Hilfen: upper, lower, trunc:N, prefix:S, suffix:S, pad:N, default:S
template_help.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: dim help text under the Template input listing the helper names usable in a template; the helper names and :N/:S suffixes are syntax and stay untranslated.

template_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: field label above the input where a text template using {value} is typed.

template_required.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: validation message under the preview while the Template input is empty; Apply stays disabled until text is entered.

template_semicolon.value: Die Vorlage darf kein Semikolon enthalten
template_semicolon.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Template tab: validation message when the template text contains a semicolon, which the format comment cannot hold; Apply is disabled.

template_tab.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Mode buttons: second of three toggle buttons, selects formatting the cell through a text template. Noun.

thousands_label.location: SQL editor → Custom formatter dialog → Number tab: checkbox label that turns grouping separators (e.g. 1,234,567) on or off in the formatted numbers.

diagnostic.value: Spalte '{column}' ist in der Auswahlliste ungültig, da sie weder in einer Aggregatfunktion noch in der GROUP BY-Klausel enthalten ist.
diagnostic.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined column: error (warning on MySQL) shown when a selected column is neither aggregated nor in GROUP BY; {column} is that column. Mirrors SQL Server error 8120.

fix_label.value: Lösen Sie dies: Fügen Sie {columns} zur GROUP BY-Klausel hinzu
fix_label.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an ungrouped column: clickable accent link under the explanation that adds the missing columns to the GROUP BY clause; {columns} is a comma-separated list of names.

accepts_label.location: SQL editor → Signature help card (shown while typing function arguments): short lowercase label before the list of fixed keywords the current argument accepts.

blocking_label.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a Redis command: label before the reason the command can block the server or connection, warning before it is run.

column_in_table.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a column: fragment after the column’s type and nullability naming its owning table; {table} is the qualified table name. Lowercase fragment.

deprecated_since.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a Redis command → Title line: note after the command group/badges when the command is deprecated; {note} is the existing note, {since} the version it was deprecated in.

example_label.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a built-in function: dim label before the function’s usage example on the same line; keep the trailing space.

more_columns.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a table or view: final dim line after the listed columns when the card shows only some; {count} is how many columns are not listed.

more_forms.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a built-in function: dim line after the first four signatures when the function has more overloads; {count} is how many more call forms exist.

overload_note.location: SQL editor → Signature help card: suffix after the signature when the function has several overloads; {current} is the shown form’s number and {total} the number of forms. Keep the leading spaces.

routine_returns.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a stored procedure or function: dim line after the parameter list giving the routine’s return type; {return_type} is the SQL type. Lowercase fragment.

since.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a Redis command: fact fragment giving the server version that introduced the command; {version} is that version number. Lowercase fragment.

system_variable_note.location: SQL editor → Hover card for a system variable (e.g. @@VERSION): dim note on the title line after the variable name identifying what kind of word it is.

clipboard_empty.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Paste in list: status-bar error when the clipboard text contains no values to turn into an IN (…) list.

clipboard_too_large.value: Zwischenablagentext ist zu groß ({actual_bytes} Bytes); das Limit beträgt {limit_bytes}.
clipboard_too_large.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Paste in list: status-bar error when the clipboard text exceeds the size limit; {actual_bytes} is its size and {limit_bytes} the maximum, both in bytes.

clipboard_too_many_values.value: Zu viele Werte ({actual_count}); das Limit beträgt {limit_count}.
clipboard_too_many_values.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Paste in list: status-bar error when the clipboard splits into more values than allowed; {actual_count} is the value count, {limit_count} the maximum.

selection_too_large.value: Die Auswahl ist zu groß ({actual_bytes} Bytes); das Limit beträgt {limit_bytes}.
selection_too_large.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Preview: warning shown in place of the preview when the selected text exceeds the size limit; {actual_bytes} is its size, {limit_bytes} the maximum, in bytes.

selection_too_many_values.value: Zu viele Werte ({actual_count}); das Limit beträgt {limit_count}.
selection_too_many_values.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Preview: warning shown in place of the preview when the selection splits into more values than allowed; {actual_count} is the count, {limit_count} the maximum.

add_param_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Parameters: button that adds a query parameter declaration.

empty_markdown_cell.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Markdown cell: placeholder shown while the cell has no content.

expand_cycle.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when cell dependencies contain a cycle; includes the cell path.

expand_not_select.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a referenced SQL cell does not contain exactly one SELECT statement.

expand_not_sql.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a referenced cell is not a SQL cell.

expand_self_reference.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a cell references itself.

expand_unknown_cell.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All expansion: error shown when a referenced cell does not exist.

export_markdown_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that exports the notebook as Markdown.

export_jupyter_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that saves a copy of the notebook as a Jupyter .ipynb file that Azure Data Studio, VS Code and Jupyter open; keep “Jupyter” unchanged.

invalid_file.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when the notebook file cannot be decoded.

invalid_ipynb_file.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when a Jupyter .ipynb file chosen to open cannot be decoded; {error} is the parser's explanation.

unsupported_ipynb_version.value: Jupyter-Notebook-Format {version} wird nicht unterstützt; öffnen und speichern Sie es zuerst in Jupyter erneut (Format 4 oder später).
unsupported_ipynb_version.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when a Jupyter .ipynb file uses an nbformat version older than 4, which SQLly cannot read; {version} is the file's nbformat number.

markdown_done_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Markdown cell editor: button that finishes editing and returns to the rendered view.

newer_version.value: Dieses Notebook wurde von einer neueren SQLLY-Version geschrieben und kann hier nicht geöffnet werden.
newer_version.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Open: error shown when the file uses a newer notebook format version.

param_name_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Parameters: placeholder in the new-parameter name field.

parameters_label.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Parameters: heading above the parameter fields.

run_all_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that runs every SQL cell in dependency order.

run_all_completed.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All: completion status reporting how many cells ran.

run_all_stopped.value: Alles ausführen gestoppt bei {cell_id} nach {count} abgeschlossenen Zellen
run_all_stopped.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All: error status identifying the failing cell and how many cells had already completed.

save_as_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that opens the Save As flow for the notebook.

save_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: button that saves the current notebook.

stop_button.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Run All: button that stops the remaining queued cells.

unsaved_badge.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Toolbar: badge shown when the notebook has unsaved changes.

writes_badge.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Cell: badge shown when the SQL cell may modify data.

convert_copy_button.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Footer: secondary button on the left that copies the converted list shown in the preview to the clipboard without changing the editor text.

convert_dialog_title.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: title of the dialog opened from Edit → Convert delimited list on the selected text, which reshapes a list of values (delimiters, quotes, wrapping).

convert_replace_button.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Footer: main button that replaces the selected editor text with the converted list from the preview. Verb.

dedupe_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: checkbox label that removes repeated values from the converted list, treating different letter case as different values.

delimiter_auto.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: first small toggle button, detects how the selected values are separated automatically.

delimiter_comma.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on commas.

delimiter_newline.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text into one value per line.

delimiter_semicolon.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on semicolons.

delimiter_space.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on spaces.

delimiter_tab.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Input delimiter buttons: small toggle button that splits the selected text on tab characters (the Tab key character, not a UI tab).

find_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace: placeholder in the find input.

find_replace_all_button.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar → Replace row: small button beside Replace that replaces every match in the editor at once; very short space.

find_replace_button.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar → Replace row: small button next to the replacement input that replaces only the current match. Verb; very short space.

find_word_button.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar → Find row: small toggle button between “Aa” and “.*” that limits matches to whole words; very short space.

format_dialog_title.location: SQL editor → Column format list: title of the small dialog listing preset formats for a column, opened from the grid column header or editor context menu; {column} is the column name.

goto_line_label.location: SQL editor → Go to line bar (Ctrl+G): label at the top right of the editor before the line-number input; {line_count} is the total number of lines in the query.

input_delimiter_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: heading above the row of buttons choosing how the selected text is split into values.

invalid_regex.location: SQL editor → Find and replace bar: red error line under the search row when regular-expression mode is on and the pattern does not compile; {error} is the parser’s message.

line_number_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Go to Line: placeholder in the line-number input.

output_delimiter_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for the text placed between values in the converted list.

prefix_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for text added before each value in the converted list.

preview_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: heading above the live monospace preview of the converted list. Noun.

quote_double.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Quote buttons: third small toggle button, wraps each value in double quote marks.

quote_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: heading above the three buttons choosing which quote marks wrap each value. Noun.

quote_none.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Quote buttons: first small toggle button, leaves values without quote marks.

quote_single.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog → Quote buttons: second small toggle button, wraps each value in single quote marks (apostrophes).

replace_placeholder.location: SQL Editor → Find and Replace: placeholder in the replace input.

suffix_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for text added after each value in the converted list.

wrap_width_label.location: SQL editor → Convert delimited list dialog: label beside the input for the line length at which the converted list wraps; 0 turns wrapping off.

cancel_delete_button.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: button that closes the prompt without deleting the SQL file or folder.

change_folder_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Options menu (⋮ in the header): item that lets the user pick a different disk folder as the SQL library root.

delete_button.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: destructive button that permanently deletes the file or folder from disk. Verb.

delete_confirm.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: warning heading after choosing Delete on an item; {name} is the file or folder name.

delete_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file or folder: item that asks for confirmation and then deletes it from disk. Verb.

delete_warning.value: Dies kann nicht rückgängig gemacht werden.
delete_warning.location: Sidebar → Library → Delete confirmation prompt: detail line under the heading warning that the deletion is permanent.

empty.value: Noch keine SQL-Dateien. In Bibliothek speichern oder .sql-Dateien in {path} legen
empty.location: Sidebar → Library: empty-state message when the library folder has no SQL files; {path} is the library folder on disk.

filter_placeholder.location: Sidebar → Library → Header filter: placeholder in the search input that narrows the library tree by file name.

name_placeholder.location: Sidebar → Library: placeholder in the inline input that appears in the tree when creating a new folder or renaming a file or folder.

open_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file: first item, opens the SQL file in a query tab (not shown for folders). Verb.

refresh_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Options menu (⋮ in the header): first item, rescans the library folder on disk to pick up added, removed or renamed files. Verb.

rename_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file or folder: item that turns the row into an inline name input to rename it on disk. Verb.

reveal_finder_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Options menu (⋮ in the header): item that opens the library root folder in the system file manager (Finder on macOS).

reveal_menu.location: Sidebar → Library → Right-click menu on a file or folder: last item, shows the item selected in the system file manager. Verb.

chart_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly chart:” comment cannot be parsed; {error} is the specific parse error, followed by the expected syntax. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

computed_column_invalid.value: Diese berechnete Spalte wird ignoriert — {error} (erwartet `-- sqlly column: <Name> = <Excel formula>`; Spalten als !Name, vorherige Zeilen als !Name[1], feste Zeilen als !Name[$1]).
computed_column_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly column:” computed-column formula cannot be parsed, so the column is dropped; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

conditional_invalid.value: Diese bedingte Direktive wird ignoriert — {error} (erwartet `-- sqlly conditional: column=<name>; when=<test>; text=#RRGGBB; fill=#RRGGBB; bold`, oder `scale=#RRGGBB..#RRGGBB`, oder `bar=#RRGGBB`).
conditional_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly conditional:” grid colouring rule cannot be parsed and is ignored; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

focus_invalid.value: Diese Fokus-Direktive wird ignoriert — erwartet wird eine 1-basierte Ergebnismengen-Nummer (`-- sqlly focus: 2`).
focus_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly focus:” comment does not give a valid result set number, so the result-tab focus is ignored. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

format_invalid.value: Diese Format-Direktive wird ignoriert — erwartet `-- sqlly format: column=<name>; <format>` (siehe Hilfe ▸ Formatierungs-Direktiven).
format_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly format:” column format comment has the right prefix but an unparseable body; points to the Help menu reference. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

format_spacing.value: Diese Formatdirektive wird ignoriert — es ist die genaue Schreibweise `-- sqlly format:` erforderlich (mit einem Leerzeichen nach `--`).
format_spacing.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a format comment is written “--sqlly format” without the space after the two dashes, so it is not applied. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

grid_invalid.value: Diese Grid-Direktive wird ignoriert — {error} (erwartet `-- sqlly grid [<n>]: order=<cols>; hide=<cols>; freeze=<n>; sort=<col> [desc]; group=<col>; filter=<col> <op> <value>; label=<col>:<column|off>`).
grid_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly grid:” layout comment (column order, hide, freeze, sort, filter) cannot be parsed; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

lines_invalid.value: Diese Zeilen-Direktive wird ignoriert — erwartet wird eine Zeilenanzahl von 1 bis {maximum} (`-- sqlly lines: 10` oder `-- sqlly lines 2: 10`).
lines_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly lines:” comment is not a row count in range; {maximum} is the largest allowed number of visible rows. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

not_first_line.value: Diese Direktive wird hier ignoriert — sie wird nur in der ersten nicht-leeren Zeile der Abfrage berücksichtigt.
not_first_line.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a view or canvas directive appears below the first non-empty line of the query, where it has no effect.

not_standalone.value: Diese Direktive wird hier ignoriert — sie wird nur berücksichtigt, wenn der Kommentar die ganze Zeile einnimmt.
not_standalone.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a directive is written after SQL code on the same line instead of on a line of its own, so it has no effect.

param_invalid.value: Diese Param-Direktive wird ignoriert — {error} (erwartet `-- sqlly param: @name <type> [= default]`).
param_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly param:” query parameter declaration cannot be parsed; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

set_invalid.value: Diese Set-Direktive wird ignoriert — {error} (erwartet `-- sqlly set <name> = <value>`).
set_invalid.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly set” value assignment cannot be parsed; {error} is the parse error. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

unknown_layout.value: Unbekanntes Layout — erwartet `-- sqlly layout: stacked`, `-- sqlly layout: tabbed` oder `-- sqlly layout: canvas`.
unknown_layout.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly layout:” comment names a result layout other than stacked, tabbed or canvas. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

unknown_view.value: Unbekannte Ansicht — erwartet `-- sqlly view: grid`, `-- sqlly view: pivot`, `-- sqlly view: chart` oder `-- sqlly view: map`.
unknown_view.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a “-- sqlly view:” comment names a result view other than grid, pivot or chart. Keep the backtick-quoted directive syntax and option names exactly as written.

unrecognized.value: Keine anerkannte SQLLY-Direktive — siehe Hilfe ▸ Formatierungsdirektiven für die unterstützten Formen.
unrecognized.location: SQL editor → Problem tooltip on an underlined “-- sqlly” directive comment: problem when a comment starts with the SQLLY directive prefix but matches no known directive; points to the Help menu reference.

action_enabled_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: checkbox label below the template body; when ticked, the saved template also appears as an action under Custom Actions in the database explorer’s right-click menu.

action_run_label.value: Sofort ausführen (Standard: in einem Abfrage-Tab zur Überprüfung öffnen; alles andere als nur-Lesen SQL wird vorher gefragt)
action_run_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: checkbox label shown once the explorer-action box is ticked; when ticked the action runs the SQL at once instead of opening it in a query tab, and non-read-only SQL still asks for confirmation first.

body_help.value: Body — Platzhalter wie <name,type,default> werden zu Parametern, wenn Sie speichern; eine Explorer-Aktion fragt zuerst nach ihren Werten, vorausgefüllt mit den Standardwerten. {server}, {database}, {schema} und {object} füllen sich aus dem angeklickten Objekt als zitierte Bezeichner, {kind} als dessen Typwort. Fügen Sie :literal für ein zitiertes String-Literal hinzu ({object:literal}) oder :raw für den reinen Text ({object:raw}, nicht maskiert).
body_help.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: help paragraph above the template body text area explaining <name,type,default> parameters and the {server}/{database}/{schema}/{object}/{kind} tokens; keep the brace tokens and :literal/:raw suffixes untranslated.

body_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: example SQL shown greyed in the empty template body text area, illustrating the <name,type,default> parameter syntax; it is SQL code and should normally stay as is.

cancel_edit_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: footer button shown while creating or editing a user template; discards the form and returns to browsing templates without saving.

catalog_read_failed.value: Der Benutzer-Template-Katalog konnte nicht gelesen werden: {error}
catalog_read_failed.location: Template Explorer and explorer Custom Actions → Template catalog load error: error shown when the saved user-template file exists but cannot be parsed (for example it is corrupt); {error} is the technical parse error.

category_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: short field label to the left of the Category input, the second field after Name.

category_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: greyed hint inside the empty Category input explaining that a template with no category is filed under the “My Templates” group in the list.

delete_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: footer button at the far left, shown only when a user-created template is selected; permanently removes that template (built-in templates cannot be deleted).

description_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: short field label to the left of the Description input, the third field after Name and Category.

description_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: greyed hint inside the empty Description input where the user types an optional one-line explanation of the template.

dialog_title.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer: title of the dialog for browsing SSMS-style SQL script templates, filling in their parameters and inserting the result into a query tab. Product feature name.

edit_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: footer button at the far left, shown only when a user-created template is selected; opens that template in the inline edit form.

filter_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: greyed hint inside the search box at the top right of the dialog; typing narrows the template list on the left.

insert_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: primary footer button, enabled once a template is selected; puts the rendered SQL from the preview into a new query editor tab and closes the dialog (nothing is executed).

name_label.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: short field label to the left of the Name input, the first field of the template form.

name_placeholder.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: greyed hint inside the empty Name input; the template cannot be saved until a name is entered.

new_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: button in the top toolbar beside the filter box that opens an empty form for creating a user template; the ellipsis means a form follows.

no_matches.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → Template list: empty-state message shown in the left-hand list when no template name matches the filter text.

no_storage.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: error shown below the template lists when saving or deleting a user template fails because the app has no data folder to store templates in; lower-case sentence fragment.

object_kind_required.value: Markieren Sie mindestens eine Objektsorte für die Explorer-Aktion
object_kind_required.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: inline error shown when saving with the explorer-action box ticked but none of the Tables/Views/Procedures/Functions object-kind checkboxes ticked.

params_cancel_button.location: Explorer → Custom Actions → Template parameters prompt: secondary button that closes the parameter prompt without scripting or running the custom action.

params_dialog_title.location: Explorer → Custom Actions → Template parameters prompt: title of the small dialog that asks for template parameter values before a custom action runs; {template} is the user template’s name.

params_run_button.location: Explorer → Custom Actions → Template parameters prompt: primary confirm button for a custom action set to run immediately; also the verb used when the prompt opens. Short imperative.

params_run_description.value: Läuft auf {target}. Werte ersetzen jeden Platzhalter wie eingegeben, genau wie SSMS-Vorlagenparameter. Alles, was nicht schreibgeschützt ist, wird vor der Ausführung zur Überprüfung angezeigt.
params_run_description.location: Explorer → Custom Actions → Template parameters prompt: explanation above the parameter inputs for a run-immediately action; {target} is the connection and object the SQL will run on (e.g. “prod · shop”).

params_script_button.location: Explorer → Custom Actions → Template parameters prompt: primary confirm button for a custom action that scripts the SQL into a new query tab instead of running it. Short imperative verb.

params_script_description.value: Skripte auf einem neuen Tab in {target}. Werte ersetzen jeden Platzhalter wie eingegeben, genau wie SSMS-Vorlagenparameter.
params_script_description.location: Explorer → Custom Actions → Template parameters prompt: explanation above the parameter inputs for a script-to-tab action; {target} is the connection and object the new tab will target.

save_button.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → New/Edit template form: primary footer button that saves the user template being created or edited; disabled until a name is entered.

save_failed.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog: error shown below the template lists when writing the user-template file to disk fails during save or delete; {error} is the operating-system error text.

select_template_empty.value: Wählen Sie eine Vorlage, um ihre Parameter auszufüllen.
select_template_empty.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → Detail pane: empty-state message shown on the right before any template is chosen from the list on the left.

user_badge.location: Tools menu → Template Explorer dialog → Template list: tiny tag shown at the right end of a row marking a template the user created (as opposed to a built-in one). Very short, lower case.

attention_enable_button.location: Activity Monitor → Toolbar: button enabling attention ranking.

copy_sql_button.location: Activity Monitor → Footer: button copying the selected row's SQL.

feature_profiler.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Relay refusal: feature name used in the direct-connection requirement.

feature_pubsub.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Relay refusal: feature name used in the direct-connection requirement.

filter_attention.location: Activity Monitor → Triage filter: button label for AI-ranked rows requiring attention.

filter_long_running.location: Activity Monitor → Triage filter: button label for sessions exceeding the long-running threshold.

filter_text_placeholder.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Filters: placeholder for the argument substring filter.

keyspace_enable_button.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Keyspace notifications: button staging the key-event configuration change.

keyspace_enable_explanation.value: Veröffentlicht jede Keyspace- (K) und Key-Event-Benachrichtigung (E) für alle Ereignisklassen (A); geringe CPU-Kosten auf stark ausgelasteten Servern. Ändert nur den laufenden Server — die Konfigurationsdatei bleibt unverändert, bis Sie auch CONFIG REWRITE aus der Registerkarte Teuer ausführen.
keyspace_enable_explanation.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Keyspace configuration review: explanation of event scope, cost, and runtime-only behavior.

keyspace_key_events_off.value: notify-keyspace-events ist {flags}: Key-Event-Kanäle (die E-Klasse) werden nicht veröffentlicht, daher bleibt die Voreinstellung für Key-Events still.

keyspace_off.value: Keyspace-Benachrichtigungen sind auf diesem Server ausgeschaltet (notify-keyspace-events ist leer): Das Key-Events-Preset bleibt still, bis sie aktiviert werden.
keyspace_off.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Keyspace notifications: explanation when notifications are disabled.

keyspace_read_failed.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Keyspace notifications: status when the setting cannot be read.

keyspace_reading.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Keyspace notifications: status while event classes load.

live_noun_messages.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Live summary: noun used in capture counters.

live_received.location: Activity Monitor → Live tools → Summary: number of entries received since capture started.

live_recording_paused.location: Activity Monitor → Live tools → Summary: state shown while capture recording is paused.

live_shown_capped.location: Activity Monitor → Live tools → Summary: display-cap explanation with the cap and buffered counts.

live_shown_filtered.location: Activity Monitor → Live tools → Summary: filtered display and buffered counts.

load_failed.location: Activity Monitor → Content: query error followed by engine-specific permission guidance.

loading.location: Activity Monitor → Content: placeholder while activity rows load.

no_rows.location: Activity Monitor → Content: empty state when the active query returns no rows.

open_query_button.location: Activity Monitor → Footer: primary button opening the selected SQL in a query tab.

payload_bytes.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Payload cell: binary preview and original byte count.

payload_bytes_truncated.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Payload cell: truncated binary preview and original byte count.

payload_text_truncated.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Payload cell: truncated text payload and original byte count.

payload_truncation_notice.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Preview Payload: explanation of retained and original payload sizes.

permission_clickhouse.value: ClickHouse zeigt Abfragen anderer Benutzer nur Benutzern mit den Berechtigungen SHOW PROCESSES / KILL QUERY; die Ansicht Teure Abfragen liest system.query_log, wofür die Abfragelogging aktiviert sein muss.
permission_clickhouse.location: Activity Monitor → Load error: permission guidance for ClickHouse activity views.

permission_mysql.value: Die Sichtbarkeit von MySQL/MariaDB-Aktivitäten kann das PRIVILEG PROCESS erfordern, und die Blocking/Waits-Ansichten erfordern außerdem performance_schema und das sys-Schema.
permission_mysql.location: Activity Monitor → Load error: permission guidance for MySQL and MariaDB activity views.

permission_postgres.value: Die Sichtbarkeit von PostgreSQL-Aktivitäten kann pg_monitor oder pg_read_all_stats erfordern; gewöhnliche Benutzer können nur begrenzte Details für andere Sitzungen sehen.
permission_postgres.location: Activity Monitor → Load error: permission guidance for PostgreSQL activity views.

permission_redis.value: Redis-Sitzungen stammen von CLIENT LIST und die Expensive-Ansicht von SLOWLOG GET; ein ACL-Benutzer benötigt die Berechtigungen +client, +slowlog und +info sowie CLIENT KILL, um eine Sitzung zu beenden.
permission_redis.location: Activity Monitor → Load error: permission guidance for Redis activity views.

permission_sql_server.value: SQL Server-Aktivitätsansichten erfordern normalerweise VIEW SERVER STATE (oder VIEW DATABASE STATE für unterstützte Azure SQL-Ansichten).
permission_sql_server.location: Activity Monitor → Load error: permission guidance for SQL Server and Azure SQL activity views.

permission_unsupported.value: Diese Engine stellt keinen unterstützten Live-Sitzungsmonitor zur Verfügung.
permission_unsupported.location: Activity Monitor → Load error: explanation shown when the connected engine has no supported activity monitor.

production_write_block.value: Die Produktion ist schreibgeschützt: Schalte Schreibvorgänge frei (1/5/15 Min.) über das Statusleisten-Chip oder die Befehlspalette, um Servereinstellungen von hier aus zu ändern.
production_write_block.location: Activity Monitor → Redis configuration: warning shown when the production lock prevents CONFIG writes.

profiler_apply_cap_button.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Toolbar: button applying the command ring-cap value.

profiler_banner.value: MONITOR überwacht jeden Befehl, den der Server ausführt, über seine eigene Verbindung — der Editor verweigert MONITOR weiterhin. Die Erfassung ist begrenzt: Die neuesten {cap} Einträge werden behalten und die ältesten bei Überlauf gelöscht (bisher {dropped} gelöscht), sodass ein stark frequentierter Server schneller sein kann und Einträge fehlen können. Die Tabelle zeigt die neuesten {display_cap} Einträge, die den Filter passieren, zuerst die neuesten. Die Erfassung stoppt automatisch nach dem Zeitfenster (Stoppen nach, jetzt {seconds} s, maximal eine Stunde); Stoppen, das Schließen dieses Tabs oder die Trennung beendet die Verbindung früher.
profiler_banner.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler: banner explaining dedicated connections, bounded capture, filtering, time box, and shutdown behavior.

profiler_clear_button.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Toolbar: button clearing buffered commands.

profiler_empty_connecting.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler: empty state while the capture connection opens.

profiler_empty_filtered.value: Keine erfassten Befehle stimmen mit dem Filter überein.
profiler_empty_filtered.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler: empty state when filters exclude all buffered commands.

profiler_empty_idle.value: Starten Sie eine Erfassung, um jeden vom Server ausgeführten Befehl zu profilieren.
profiler_empty_idle.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler: empty state before capture starts.

profiler_empty_waiting.value: Noch keine Befehle erfasst — warte auf Serveraktivität.
profiler_empty_waiting.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler: empty state while waiting for commands.

profiler_idle.value: Profiler untätig — Start öffnet eine dedizierte MONITOR-Verbindung
profiler_idle.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Summary: idle state before capture starts.

profiler_pause_button.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Toolbar: button pausing command recording.

profiler_resume_button.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Toolbar: button resuming command recording.

profiler_start_button.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Toolbar: button starting command capture.

profiler_stop_after_label.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Toolbar: label beside the capture time-box seconds field.

profiler_stop_button.location: Activity Monitor → Profiler → Toolbar: button stopping command capture.

pubsub_apply_cap_button.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub → Toolbar: button applying the message ring-cap value.

pubsub_banner.value: Abonnements laufen über ihre eigene Verbindung — der Editor weigert sich weiterhin, SUBSCRIBE auszuführen. Die Liste ist begrenzt: die neuesten {cap} Nachrichten werden aufbewahrt, die ältesten bei Überlauf verworfen (bisher {dropped} verworfen); die Tabelle zeigt die neuesten {display_cap}, die neuesten zuerst. Namen, die Glob-Zeichen (* ? [ ]) enthalten, werden über PSUBSCRIBE als Muster abonniert, der Rest als einfache Kanäle; beginnt ein Name mit =, wird er wörtlich abonniert (=orders[eu]). Key Events abonniert die Keyspace-Benachrichtigungen dieser Datenbank; diese Nachrichten füllen die Spalten Event und Key. Pause hält die Liste, ohne das Abonnement zu schließen. Stop, das Verlassen dieses Tabs oder das Trennen der Verbindung schließt die Verbindung.
pubsub_banner.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub: banner explaining dedicated connections, bounded capture, pattern syntax, key events, pause, and shutdown behavior.

pubsub_empty_connecting.location: Activity Monitor → Pub/Sub: empty state while the subscription connection opens.

select_tool.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: first tool toggle button, used to pick, move and resize existing arrows and boxes. Short verb.

select_tool_tooltip.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: tooltip on the Select tool button; (V) is its keyboard shortcut and must stay.

send_button.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window: primary footer button that validates the message and submits the feedback with the annotated screenshot, then closes the window.

undo_button.location: Help menu → Send Feedback window → Annotation toolbar: small button after the tool buttons that reverts the last arrow or black-box change on the screenshot.

dialog_title.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense: title of the dialog (or popped-out window) opened with F2 or the hint chip on the completion popup, used to report what the autocomplete should have suggested.

disabled_search_placeholder.location: IntelliSense → Feedback Report → Object selection: disabled search text shown while Include all owns object selection.

disclosure_capture.value: Ihre Notiz, die Abfrage und der Cursor, die Vorschläge des Popups (mit Bild davon), wie es ausgelöst wurde und die App-Version sowie die Plattform.
disclosure_capture.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → What will be sent: first bullet listing the captured items — the user’s note, the query and cursor position, the suggestion list with an image of it, the trigger, and app version/platform.

disclosure_heading.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Right pane: bold heading above the bullet list that discloses exactly what data the report will upload.

disclosure_masked.value: Literals und Kommentare sind als <redacted> maskiert.
disclosure_masked.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → What will be sent: bullet shown while “Mask literals” is on, stating that string literals and comments are replaced by the literal token <redacted> (keep that token as is).

disclosure_names.value: Namen (nie Daten) der Elemente, die Sie links markieren, plus die Objekte, aus denen die Vorschläge stammen, die erforderlich sind.
disclosure_names.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → What will be sent: bullet explaining that only names (never row data) of objects ticked in the left-hand tree are sent, plus the required objects behind the suggestions.

disclosure_never.value: Nie: Ergebnisse, Tabellendaten, Zugangsdaten, API-Schlüssel oder irgendetwas Unabgehaktes.
disclosure_never.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → What will be sent: last bullet listing what is never uploaded — query results, table data, credentials, API keys, or unticked items.

disclosure_unmasked.value: Literalwerte und Kommentare werden so gesendet, wie sie getippt wurden, es sei denn, Sie maskieren sie.
disclosure_unmasked.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → What will be sent: bullet shown while literals are unmasked, stating that string literals and comments in the query are sent exactly as typed.

expectation_placeholder.value: Was hätte es anbieten sollen? Fügen Sie alle Details hinzu, die uns helfen, es nachzuvollziehen.
expectation_placeholder.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Right pane: greyed hint inside the note text box below the query, asking what the autocomplete should have suggested.

expectation_required.value: Sagen Sie uns, was es hätte anbieten sollen.
expectation_required.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Right pane: red validation error under the note box shown when Submit is clicked with the note empty.

fk_chains_accessibility.value: Schließen Sie Multi-Hop-Fremdschlüssel-Beziehungsketten in den Bericht ein
fk_chains_accessibility.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: screen-reader label for the “Relationship chains” checkbox, describing that it adds multi-hop foreign-key paths to the report.

fk_chains_label.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: small checkbox label after the object-kind toggles, shown only when foreign-key chains exist; adds multi-hop relationship paths between included tables.

include_all_accessibility.value: Schließen Sie das gesamte Verbindungsdatenmodell in den Bericht ein
include_all_accessibility.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: screen-reader label for the “Include all” checkbox beside the search box, describing that it sends the whole connection’s data model.

include_all_label.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: checkbox label next to the search box; when ticked, every object name in the data model is sent and the tree is greyed out.

include_all_summary.value: Ihr gesamtes Datenmodell (nur Namen — niemals Daten) wird einbezogen.
include_all_summary.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree shown while “Include all” is ticked, replacing the ticked-item count.

kind_columns.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides columns in the tree (fifth of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_functions.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides functions in the tree (third of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_procedures.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides stored procedures in the tree (first of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_tables.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides tables in the tree (fourth of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_toggle_accessibility.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: screen-reader label for each object-kind visibility checkbox; {kind} is one of the lower-case plural kind words (tables, views, columns…).

kind_types.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides user-defined data types in the tree (last of six). Plural noun, very short.

kind_views.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: lower-case label of the object-kind visibility checkbox that shows or hides views in the tree (second of six). Plural noun, very short.

mask_literals_button.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: small toggle button beside “Your query”, shown when the query has literals or comments; replaces them with <redacted> in the report.

mask_literals_tooltip.value: Ersetze String-Literale und Kommentare vor dem Senden durch <redacted>
mask_literals_tooltip.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: tooltip on the “Mask literals” button explaining it hides string literals and comments behind the token <redacted> (keep that token).

no_data_model.value: Es wurde kein Datenmodell für diese Verbindung erfasst.
no_data_model.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: empty-state message in the tree when no schema information was cached for the current connection.

no_search_matches.value: Kein Eintrag in Ihrem Datenmodell entspricht "{query}".
no_search_matches.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: empty-state message in the tree when the search box text matches no object; {query} is the typed search text.

query_heading.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Right pane: bold heading above the read-only copy of the user’s query; {line} and {column} give the caret position when the autocomplete popup was captured.

required_badge.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: tiny accent-coloured tag at the end of a locked tree row whose object backed one of the suggestions and is always sent. Single short word, not an error.

required_explanation.value: Erforderlich: Dieser Punkt gehörte zu den Vorschlägen, die Ihnen angeboten wurden. Tests, die aus diesem Bericht erstellt werden, benötigen ihn, um gültig zu sein.
required_explanation.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: tooltip on locked rows and notice under the tree after clicking one, explaining why that object cannot be unticked.

search_overflow.value: … {count} weitere — grenzen Sie Ihre Suche ein
search_overflow.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: last row of the tree when search results are capped; {count} is how many further matching objects are hidden.

search_placeholder.location: IntelliSense → Feedback Report → Object selection: placeholder in the schema object search input.

selection_both_many.value: {picked} markierte Elemente plus {required} erforderlich — ausgegraute Kästchen senden nur den Namen.
selection_both_many.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when several items are ticked and some are required; {picked} is the ticked count (plural), {required} the required count.

selection_both_one.value: {picked} markiertes Element plus {required} erforderlich — ausgegraute Kästchen senden nur den Namen.
selection_both_one.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when exactly one item is ticked plus some required ones; {picked} is 1, {required} the required count.

selection_none.value: Nichts markiert: Es werden keine Datenmodellnamen gesendet.
selection_none.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when nothing is ticked and no objects are required, so no schema names will be uploaded.

selection_picked_many.value: {picked} markierte Elemente — ausgegraute Kästchen senden nur den Namen.
selection_picked_many.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when two or more items are ticked and none are required; {picked} is the ticked count.

selection_picked_one.value: {picked} markiertes Element — ausgegraute Kästchen senden nur den Namen.
selection_picked_one.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when exactly one item is ticked and none are required; {picked} is 1.

selection_required_many.value: {required} erforderliche Elemente aus den Vorschlägen werden gesendet.
selection_required_many.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when nothing is ticked but two or more suggestion-backing items will be sent anyway; {required} is that count. Informational, not an error.

selection_required_one.value: {required} erforderliches Element aus den Vorschlägen wird gesendet.
selection_required_one.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: summary line under the tree when nothing is ticked but exactly one suggestion-backing item will be sent anyway; {required} is 1. Informational, not an error.

snippets_group.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Data-model tree pane: name of the group row in the tree that lists the editor snippets known to IntelliSense.

submit_button.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog: primary footer button that validates the note and queues the IntelliSense report for upload.

suggestions_summary.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog: summary line at the top of the dialog when the captured popup had no top items to name; {count} is the number of suggestions recorded.

suggestions_summary_top.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog: summary line at the top of the dialog; {count} is the number of suggestions recorded and {top} a comma-separated list of the first few suggestion names.

truncation_dropped_chains.location: Improve IntelliSense → Uploaded report: lower-case note recorded in the report when it exceeds the size budget and all foreign-key chains are removed; {count} is how many were dropped.

truncation_dropped_objects.location: Improve IntelliSense → Uploaded report: lower-case note recorded when the report is over its size budget and schema objects are cut; {dropped} removed out of {total} objects.

truncation_dropped_procedures.location: Improve IntelliSense → Uploaded report: lower-case note recorded when the report is over its size budget and stored-procedure definitions are cut; {dropped} removed out of {total} procedures.

unmask_literals_button.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: label of the literals toggle button while masking is on; clicking it sends string literals and comments as typed again.

unmask_literals_tooltip.value: String-Literale und Kommentare genau so senden, wie sie eingegeben wurden
unmask_literals_tooltip.location: Query editor → Improve IntelliSense dialog → Query heading: tooltip on the “Unmask literals” button explaining that literals and comments will be sent exactly as typed.

capture_empty.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the captured window image has zero width or height.

capture_failed.value: das Fenster konnte nicht erfasst werden
capture_failed.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the operating system returns no image for the app window.

capture_truncated.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the captured image data is shorter than its declared size.

pixel_data_missing.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the captured image carries no readable pixel bytes.

pixel_format_unsupported.value: nicht unterstütztes Pixel-Format für die Erfassung
pixel_format_unsupported.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case technical fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the capture is not 8-bit, 32-bits-per-pixel colour.

pixel_layout_unsupported.value: nicht unterstütztes Pixel-Layout für die Erfassung
pixel_layout_unsupported.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case technical fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the capture’s colour-channel order is not one the app can convert.

platform_unsupported.value: Screenshots werden auf dieser Plattform noch nicht unterstützt
platform_unsupported.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” on Windows and Linux, where window screenshots are not implemented yet.

window_unidentified.value: das Fenster konnte nicht identifiziert werden
window_unidentified.location: Help menu → Send Feedback → Screenshot capture failure reason: lower-case fragment shown inside “Screenshot unavailable — {reason}” when the app cannot find the macOS window number to capture.

retry_interval_many.location: Workbench → Status bar → Feedback upload warning: retry interval inserted as {interval} when a submitted report was saved locally but upload failed; {count} is the minutes between retries.

retry_interval_one.location: Workbench → Status bar → Feedback upload warning: singular retry interval inserted as {interval} when retries happen every single minute (reads like “every minute”); a bare noun.

documentation_footer.value: Für weitere Hilfe siehe die Dokumentation unter https://sqlly.app/docs
documentation_footer.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window: closing line at the very bottom of the generated help text, after the shortcut lists, pointing the reader to the online SQLLY documentation; keep the web address unchanged.

editor_section.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window: section heading placed after the application command lists, introducing the list of SQL editor actions and their current keyboard shortcuts; appears on its own line.

introduction.value:
SQLLY-Hilfe

Jede Tastenkombination unten wird aus Ihren aktuellen Einstellungen aufgelöst, einschließlich aller Änderungen unter Einstellungen > Tastenkombinationen.
introduction.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window: opening title and paragraph at the top of the generated help text, explaining that every listed shortcut reflects the user’s current keybindings, including changes made in Preferences → Keybindings.

key_backspace.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: name of the Backspace key as printed inside a keyboard shortcut (after any modifier symbols); use the conventional key-cap name for this key in the target language.

key_delete.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: name of the forward Delete key as printed inside a keyboard shortcut (after any modifier symbols); use the conventional key-cap name in the target language.

key_enter.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: name of the Enter/Return key as printed inside a keyboard shortcut, e.g. the Run query shortcut; use the conventional key-cap name in the target language.

key_escape.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: abbreviated name of the Escape key as printed inside a keyboard shortcut; keep it as short as a key-cap label.

key_space.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: name of the Space bar as printed inside a keyboard shortcut, e.g. the trigger-completions shortcut; use the conventional key-cap name in the target language.

key_tab.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help window → Shortcut column: name of the Tab key as printed inside a keyboard shortcut (after any modifier symbols); use the conventional key-cap name in the target language.

back_button.location: Help menu → Tip of the Day dialog → Footer: secondary button that steps back to the previous tip in the rotating list (wraps around from the first tip to the last).

counter.location: Help menu → Tip of the Day dialog: small dimmed line above the tip title showing the position in the tip list; {current} is the number of the tip on screen and {total} is how many tips exist.

dialog_title.location: Help menu → Tip of the Day dialog: title of the modal dialog that shows one usage tip, opened automatically once per launch or on demand from Help → Tip of the Day.

next_button.location: Help menu → Tip of the Day dialog → Footer: primary button that advances to the next tip in the rotating list; the next launch then continues from the tip after the last one viewed.

show_on_startup.location: Help menu → Tip of the Day dialog → Footer: checkbox label at the left of the button row; when checked, a tip opens automatically each time SQLLY starts (same preference as in Settings → Appearance).

command_palette_body.value: Drücken Sie {modifier_key}+Shift+P, um die Befehls-Palette zu öffnen: jeder Menübefehl, durchsuchbar nach Name, Kategorie oder Schlüsselwort, mit der aktuellen Tastenkombination daneben angezeigt. Wenn Sie sie mit einer leeren Suche öffnen, werden zunächst die zuletzt verwendeten Befehle aufgelistet.
command_palette_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Press {modifier_key}+Shift+P to open the command palette: every menu command, searchable by name, category, or keyword, with its current keyboard shortcut sho…: body text for this specific tip.

command_palette_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Every command, one shortcut away: title text for this specific tip.

connection_string_body.value: Fügen Sie im Verbindungseditor eine postgres://, mysql://, sqlserver://, JDBC- oder ADO.NET-Verbindungszeichenfolge ein, und SQLLY füllt die Engine, den Host, den Port, die Datenbank, den Benutzer und die Verschlüsselungsoptionen aus. Jedes Passwort wird direkt im sicheren Speicher Ihres Betriebssystems gespeichert.
connection_string_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → In the connection editor, paste a postgres://, mysql://, sqlserver://, JDBC, or ADO.NET-style connection string and SQLLY fills in the engine, host, …: body text for this specific tip.

connection_string_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Paste a connection string: title text for this specific tip.

current_statement_body.value: Schalten Sie den Umschalter „Nur aktuelle Anweisung ausführen“ in der Abfrage-Symbolleiste ein, und Ausführen führt nur die Anweisung unter dem Cursor aus, anstatt das gesamte Skript. Eine Auswahl hat weiterhin Vorrang, wenn eine vorhanden ist.
current_statement_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Turn on the "Run current statement only" toggle in the query toolbar and Execute runs only the statement under the caret instead of the whole script.…: body text for this specific tip.

current_statement_title.value: Führen Sie nur die Anweisung aus, auf der Sie sich befinden
current_statement_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Run just the statement you're on: title text for this specific tip.

estimated_plan_body.value: Abfrage ▸ Abfrage erklären (Geschätzt, ohne Ausführung) fragt den Optimierer, wie er Ihr SQL ausführen würde — sogar ein UPDATE oder DELETE — ohne eine einzige Anweisung auszuführen. Der Plan wird im selben Bereich wie die tatsächlichen Pläne geöffnet, klar als Geschätzt gekennzeichnet.
estimated_plan_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Query ▸ Explain Query (Estimated, No Execution) asks the optimizer how it would run your SQL — even an UPDATE or DELETE — without executing a single …: body text for this specific tip.

estimated_plan_title.value: Sehen Sie den Plan, ohne etwas auszuführen
estimated_plan_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → See the plan without running anything: title text for this specific tip.

explorer_filter_body.value: Der Explorer-Filter versteht Abkürzungen wie SOH für SalesOrderHeader und /regex/-Muster. Heften Sie die Objekte, die Sie am häufigsten verwenden, oben auf dem jeweiligen Server an. Ziehen Sie eine Tabelle oder Spalte in den Editor, um ihren korrekt in Anführungszeichen gesetzten Namen einzufügen.
explorer_filter_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → The explorer filter understands abbreviations like SOH for SalesOrderHeader and /regex/ patterns. Pin the objects you use most to the top of their se…: body text for this specific tip.

explorer_filter_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Find objects faster in the explorer: title text for this specific tip.

foreign_key_body.value: Klicke mit der rechten Maustaste auf eine Zelle, die auf eine andere Tabelle verweist, und wähle Referenzierte Zeile öffnen: SQLLY öffnet einen neuen Abfrage-Tab, der die übergeordnete Zeile auswählt, auf derselben Verbindung, die das Ergebnis erzeugt hat.
foreign_key_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Right-click a cell that references another table and choose Open Referenced Row: SQLLY opens a new query tab selecting the parent row, on the same co…: body text for this specific tip.

foreign_key_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Follow a foreign key: title text for this specific tip.

format_on_run_body.value: Aktivieren Sie Fmt in der Abfrage-Symbolleiste. Jede Ausführung formatiert dann zuerst den gesamten Puffer. Die Formatierung lässt sich in einem Schritt rückgängig machen und beeinträchtigt die Ausführung nicht, wenn Sie Text dafür ausgewählt haben.
format_on_run_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Switch on the Fmt toggle in the query toolbar and each Run formats the whole buffer first. The format is a single undo step, and it stays out of the …: body text for this specific tip.

format_on_run_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Format on every run: title text for this specific tip.

history_body.value: Jeder Abfrage-Tab führt eine eigene Zeitleiste seines Textes, gespeichert bei jedem Ausführen und immer, wenn Sie nach der Bearbeitung pausieren. Öffnen Sie das Verlaufsfenster, um eine frühere Version wiederherzustellen — Ihr aktueller Text wird zuerst gespeichert, und die Wiederherstellung ist ein einziger Rückgängig-Schritt.
history_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Each query tab keeps a timeline of its own text, saved on every run and whenever you pause after editing. Open the History panel to restore an earlie…: body text for this specific tip.

history_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Every query has a history: title text for this specific tip.

hover_body.value: Bewegen Sie den Zeiger auf einen Tabellennamen, Spaltennamen, Prozedur- oder Funktionsnamen im Editor, um deren Spalten und Typen, den Typ und die Nullbarkeit einer Spalte oder die Parameterliste einer Routine zu sehen — ohne Ihre Abfrage zu verlassen.
hover_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Rest the pointer on a table, column, procedure, or function name in the editor to see its columns and types, a column's type and nullability, or a ro…: body text for this specific tip.

hover_title.value: Schweben, um das Schema zu überprüfen
hover_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Hover to check the schema: title text for this specific tip.

intellisense_body.value: Während Sie tippen, schlägt SQLLY die Tabellen, Spalten, Schlüsselwörter und sogar komplette JOINs vor, die an Ihrer Stelle passen, basierend auf Ihrer verbundenen Datenbank. Wenn ein Vorschlag falsch oder fehlend ist, drücken Sie F2, während das Vervollständigungs-Popup geöffnet ist (oder klicken Sie auf den F2-Hinweis), um einen Bericht zur Verbesserung von IntelliSense zu senden — Sie wählen genau aus, welche Schemanamen geteilt werden, und Berichte werden zu dauerhaften Regressionstests. Für alles andere — einen Fehler, eine Idee, einen verwirrenden Bildschirm — verwenden Sie Hilfe ▸ Feedback senden…, um einen Screenshot zu senden, den Sie mit Pfeilen markieren können, wobei private Bereiche geschwärzt werden, bevor irgendetwas Ihren Rechner verlässt.
intellisense_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → As you type, SQLLY suggests the tables, columns, keywords, and even complete JOINs that fit where you are, drawn from your connected database. When a…: body text for this specific tip.

intellisense_title.value: IntelliSense und uns mitteilen, was wir beheben sollen
intellisense_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → IntelliSense, and telling us what to fix: title text for this specific tip.

joins_body.value: Nach einem Tabellennamen bietet die Autovervollständigung eine vollständige JOIN … ON-Klausel an, die aus den Fremdschlüsseln dieser Tabelle erstellt wird. Tippen Sie zuerst i, l, r oder o, um einen INNER, LEFT, RIGHT oder FULL OUTER JOIN zu erhalten.
joins_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → After a table name, autocomplete offers a complete JOIN … ON clause built from that table's foreign keys. Type i, l, r, or o first to get an INNER, L…: body text for this specific tip.

joins_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → JOINs written for you: title text for this specific tip.

multicursor_body.value: Halten Sie Alt (Option auf einem Mac) gedrückt und ziehen Sie, oder drücken Sie Shift+Alt+Auf/Ab, um dieselben Spalten über mehrere Zeilen hinweg auszuwählen – jede Zeile erhält ihren eigenen Cursor, sodass Tippen, Löschen und Einfügen auf alle angewendet wird.
multicursor_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Hold Alt (Option on a Mac) and drag, or press Shift+Alt+Up/Down, to select the same columns across several lines — each line gets its own caret, so t…: body text for this specific tip.

multicursor_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Edit many lines at once: title text for this specific tip.

object_jump_body.value: Drücken Sie {modifier_key}+P (Gehe zu Objekt…) und geben Sie ein paar Buchstaben ein, um jede Verbindung, Datenbank, Tabelle, Ansicht, Prozedur und Funktion, die im Explorer geladen ist, unscharf zu durchsuchen. Etwas nachschlagen ändert niemals, mit welchem Server Ihr Abfrage-Tab verbunden ist.
object_jump_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Press {modifier_key}+P (Go to Object…) and type a few letters to fuzzy-search every connection, database, table, view, procedure, and function loaded in the e…: body text for this specific tip.

object_jump_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Jump straight to any object: title text for this specific tip.

parameters_body.value: Fügen Sie eine Zeile wie `-- sqlly param: @customer_id int = 42` zu einer Abfrage hinzu, und über den Ergebnissen erscheint ein Parameterfeld mit einem Eingabefeld pro Parameter. Beim Ausführen wird jedes @name durch ein sicher maskiertes Literal für Ihre Engine ersetzt, und kürzlich verwendete Werte werden als anklickbare Chips angeboten.
parameters_body.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Add a line like `-- sqlly param: @customer_id int = 42` to a query and a parameter strip appears above the results with one typed field per parameter…: body text for this specific tip.

parameters_title.location: Help → Tip of the Day → Typed query parameters: title text for this specific tip.

paste_in_body.value: Haben Sie eine Spalte aus einer Tabelle oder eine Liste von IDs aus einem Ticket kopiert? filter_all_tools.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Toolbar: first option of the tool filter dropdown (leftmost dropdown); selecting it shows calls to every MCP tool.

footer.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Footer: summary line under the grid; {filtered_count} is how many log records match the current filters, {total_count} is how many were loaded, and {path} is the folder holding the audit log files.

outcome_error.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog: outcome value, used both in the Outcome column and the outcome filter dropdown, for an MCP tool call that failed while running (a noun, not a dialog title).

outcome_ok.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog: outcome value, used both in the Outcome column and the outcome filter dropdown, for an MCP tool call that completed successfully; very short.

outcome_refused.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog: outcome value, used both in the Outcome column and the outcome filter dropdown, for an MCP tool call that SQLLY blocked, for example by a connection safety rule.

refresh_button.location: Settings → MCP → MCP Activity dialog → Toolbar: small button right of the three filter dropdowns that reloads the audit log from disk to pick up new MCP calls.

estimate_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: message shown when an AI client proposes a data-changing statement and SQLLY could neither count the affected rows nor summarise a query plan for it.

estimate_unavailable_reason.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: message shown when the impact estimate for an AI-proposed write statement failed; {reason} is the database error or timeout explanation.

estimated_rows.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: impact estimate shown before running an AI-proposed UPDATE or DELETE; {rows} is the number of rows its WHERE clause currently matches.

estimated_rows_with_plan.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: impact estimate with plan for an AI-proposed UPDATE or DELETE; {rows} is the number of matching rows and {plan} is a one-line summary of the top query plan operator.

plan_rows.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: one-line query plan summary inserted into the impact estimate; {node_type} is the top plan operator (e.g. a table scan) and {rows} is the planner’s estimated row count.

query_timeout.location: Workbench → Status bar and Notification Center → MCP write proposal pre-flight: reason text, inserted after “Estimate unavailable:”, used when the row count or plan query for an AI-proposed write took longer than 5 seconds and was abandoned; starts lowercase.

about.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): first item; opens the About window with the version, license and acknowledgments.

check_updates.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): item under About, shown in editions that update themselves, that checks the server for a newer SQLLY version.

preferences.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): item that opens the Settings window; use the standard macOS name for the app preferences command.

quit.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): last item; quits the SQLLY application; use the standard macOS name for the quit command.

services.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): submenu holding the system Services provided by macOS; use the standard macOS name for this submenu.

title.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY application menu: title of the macOS application menu, the first menu next to the Apple menu; it is the product name, normally left untranslated.

unlock.location: Application menu bar → SQLLY menu (macOS): item under About, shown only in the Mac App Store edition, that opens the in-app purchase window to unlock the full version.

add_cursor_above.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Multi-cursor group: item that adds an extra text cursor on the line above in the SQL editor.

add_cursor_below.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Multi-cursor group: item that adds an extra text cursor on the line below in the SQL editor.

add_cursor_next_occurrence.value: Cursor für das nächste Vorkommen hinzufügen
add_cursor_next_occurrence.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Multi-cursor group: item that adds a cursor at the next occurrence of the selected text or word in the SQL editor.

add_line_comment.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Comment group: item that comments out the current or selected lines in the SQL editor with “--”, even if already commented.

convert_delimited_list.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → List tools group: item that opens a dialog converting the selected comma-, tab- or line-separated text into another delimited or quoted list.

copy.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Clipboard group: standard item that copies the current selection to the clipboard.

cut.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Clipboard group: standard item that removes the current selection and places it on the clipboard.

find.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Search group: item that opens the find bar in the SQL editor to search the query text.

find_next.location: Application menu bar → Edit menu → Search group: item that jumps to the next match of the current search text in the SQL editor.
