opened_many.location: Workbench → Status bar: message after an app using SQLly Embedded launched SQLly and opened several query tabs without a connection; {count} is the number of tabs. Nothing has run yet, the user should review first.

opened_many_connected.value: Geöffnete {count} Abfragen aus Ihrer App — vor der Ausführung überprüfen.
opened_many_connected.location: Workbench → Status bar: message after an app using SQLly Embedded launched SQLly, connected, and opened several query tabs on that connection; {count} is the number of tabs (connection not named). Nothing has run yet.

opened_one.value: Eine Abfrage aus Ihrer App geöffnet — vor dem Ausführen überprüfen.
opened_one.location: Workbench → Status bar: message after an app using SQLly Embedded launched SQLly and opened a single query tab without a connection. Nothing has run yet; the user should review it first.

opened_one_connected.value: Eine Abfrage auf {connection} aus Ihrer App geöffnet — vor dem Ausführen überprüfen.
opened_one_connected.location: Workbench → Status bar: message after an app using SQLly Embedded launched SQLly and opened one query tab on a connection; {connection} is the connection name. Nothing has run yet.

clear_group_button.location: Run on… dialog → Environment group header: small button that unticks every connection in this group; shown in place of “Select all” when all of the group's connections are ticked.

dialog_title.location: Run on… dialog → Title bar: title of the dialog where the user ticks several saved connections to run the current statement against each one. The ellipsis is part of the title.

production_detail.location: Run on… dialog → Connection row: detail line for a connection tagged as Production; {detail} is the server/database summary, followed by a production warning word.

run_many.location: Run on… dialog → Footer: primary button label when zero or several connections are ticked; {count} is the number of selected connections (disabled at 0).

run_one.location: Run on… dialog → Footer: primary button label when exactly one connection is ticked; runs the current statement on that one connection.

select_group_button.location: Run on… dialog → Environment group header: small button that ticks every connection in this environment group (e.g. all Production connections).

subtitle.value: Führt die aktuelle Anweisung einmal pro ausgewählter Verbindung aus.
subtitle.location: Run on… dialog → Subtitle: explanatory subtitle under the title stating that the current statement runs once on each ticked connection.

equals_required.value: = wird zwischen Name und Wert benötigt
equals_required.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics: reason inserted into the “set directive is ignored” underline message when a “-- sqlly set” line has no “=” between the variable name and its value.

invalid_default.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics: reason inserted into the “param directive is ignored” underline message when a “-- sqlly param:” default value does not fit the declared type; {error} is the type error.

missing_value_many.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when Run is pressed but several declared query parameters have neither a typed value nor a default; {names} is a comma-separated list of @names. The first one is focused.

missing_value_one.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when Run is pressed but one declared query parameter has neither a typed value nor a default; {names} is that single @name, which is then focused in the Parameters strip.

name_requires_at.value: der Parametername muss mit @ oder : beginnen
name_requires_at.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics: reason inserted into the “param directive is ignored” underline message when a “-- sqlly param:” line does not start with an @name or :name. Lowercase fragment.

named_value_invalid.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when Run is pressed and a query parameter value fails validation; {name} is the @parameter name and {error} the type error (e.g. “not a valid date”).

type_required.value: ein Typ wird nach dem Namen benötigt
type_required.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics: reason inserted into the “param directive is ignored” underline message when a “-- sqlly param: @name” line has no type after the name. Lowercase fragment.

value_required.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics: reason inserted into the “set directive is ignored” underline message when a “-- sqlly set name =” line has nothing after the equals sign. Lowercase fragment.

value_type_invalid.location: Query tab → Parameters strip and Run errors: validation reason shown beside a parameter input (or inside other errors) when the value does not parse as the declared type; {parameter_type} is an untranslated type name such as date, int, uuid.

variable_characters_invalid.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics: reason inserted into the “set directive is ignored” message when a “-- sqlly set” variable name has characters other than letters, digits or underscores.

variable_name_required.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics: reason inserted into the “set directive is ignored” message when a “-- sqlly set” line has nothing before the “=”. Lowercase fragment.

variable_sigil_forbidden.value: Variablennamen dürfen nicht mit @, $, oder : beginnen
variable_sigil_forbidden.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics: reason inserted into the “set directive is ignored” message when a “-- sqlly set” variable name begins with @, $ or : (variables are declared without a prefix symbol).

variable_start_invalid.value: Variablenname muss mit einem Buchstaben oder Unterstrich beginnen
variable_start_invalid.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics: reason inserted into the “set directive is ignored” message when a “-- sqlly set” variable name begins with a digit or other character instead of a letter or underscore.

default_status.location: Query tab → Parameters strip → Parameter row: dim status beside an empty input saying the declared default will be used; {value} is that default value.

generate_uuid_button.location: Query tab → Parameters strip → uuid parameter row: small button beside the input that fills it with a freshly generated random UUID.

generate_uuid_tooltip.location: Query tab → Parameters strip → uuid parameter row: tooltip on the “Generate UUID” button explaining it inserts a new random UUID into the input.

header.value: Parameter — werden so ersetzt, wie sie eingegeben wurden, maskierte Literale beim Ausführen
header.location: Query tab → Parameters strip: header line of the band of parameter inputs above the results, explaining values are inserted as safely escaped literals when the query runs.

placeholder_binary.location: Query tab → Parameters strip: placeholder in the input of a binary parameter, showing hex notation and that NULL is allowed; keep the hex sample as is.

placeholder_bool.location: Query tab → Parameters strip: placeholder in the input of a bool parameter, showing that true or false (or NULL) is expected; keep “true”, “false”, “NULL” untranslated.

placeholder_date.location: Query tab → Parameters strip: placeholder in the input of a date parameter, showing the expected year-month-day format and that NULL is allowed.

placeholder_datetime.location: Query tab → Parameters strip: placeholder in the input of a datetime parameter, showing the expected date and time-of-day format and that NULL is allowed.

placeholder_json.location: Query tab → Parameters strip: placeholder in the input of a json parameter, showing a sample JSON object and that NULL is allowed; keep the JSON sample syntax intact.

placeholder_time.location: Query tab → Parameters strip: placeholder in the input of a time parameter, showing the expected hours:minutes:seconds format and that NULL is allowed.

placeholder_value.location: Query tab → Parameters strip: generic placeholder in the input of a text, number or decimal parameter, saying to type a value or NULL.

placeholder_auto.location: Query tab → Parameters strip → Parameter row: placeholder text inside the input of a :name or ? placeholder found in the SQL, hinting at how the value is read.

auto_type_tooltip.value: Im SQL gefunden. Zahlen, true/false und NULL werden wie eingegeben verwendet; alles andere wird als Text in Anführungszeichen gesetzt. Deklarieren Sie -- sqlly param: :name int (oder date, text, …), um den Typ festzulegen.
auto_type_tooltip.location: Query tab → Parameters strip → Parameter row: tooltip over the “auto” type label of a placeholder found in the SQL without a -- sqlly param: declaration.

required_status.location: Query tab → Parameters strip → Parameter row: red status beside an input that is empty and has no declared default, meaning a value must be entered before Run.

summary.location: Run Statements dialog → Checklist summary line (reads only): summary line under the statement checklist when only read statements are ticked; {selected} is the ticked count, {total} the number of statements in the script.

summary_updates.location: Run Statements dialog → Checklist summary line (with UPDATEs): summary line under the checklist when ticked statements include UPDATEs; {selected} ticked of {total}, {update_count} is how many are UPDATE (keep UPDATE as the SQL keyword).

summary_writes.location: Run Statements dialog → Checklist summary line (with writes): summary line when ticked statements include writes but no UPDATE; {selected} ticked of {total}, {write_count} is how many statements modify data or schema.

issue_count_many.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL result: plural count of findings inserted into the validation summary; {count} is the number of issues (2+, or 0 in some cases).

issue_count_one.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL result: singular count inserted into the validation summary when the SQL has exactly one finding.

severity_confirmation.location: AI panel → Generated SQL review: severity label before an issue that needs explicit confirmation, such as UPDATE or DELETE without a WHERE clause affecting a whole table.

severity_error.location: AI panel → Generated SQL review: severity label before an issue that blocks running the generated SQL (e.g. a parse error or unknown object). Noun, followed by a colon and the message.

severity_info.location: AI panel → Generated SQL review: severity label before a purely informational note about the generated SQL. Short noun, followed by a colon and the message.

severity_warning.location: AI panel → Generated SQL review: severity label before a non-blocking warning about the generated SQL. Noun, followed by a colon and the message.

summary_confirmation.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL result: summary when the SQL contains an operation needing confirmation (e.g. no WHERE clause); {issue_count} is the already-formatted issue count such as “2 issues”.

summary_ok.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL result: summary inserted after “Validation summary:” when the SQL validated with no issues at all.

checking.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: dim progress message shown while the dialog checks whether the server’s statistics source is enabled; {source} is the source name, e.g. “SQL Server Query Store”.

cumulative_since_reset.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer buttons: disabled time-window button label for engines whose statistics cannot be filtered by time (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle); means figures accumulate since the statistics were last reset.

cumulative_statistics.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer caption: lowercase phrase filling the {window} slot of the top-queries caption when the engine has no time window, e.g. “…by avg duration (cumulative statistics)”.

current_database.location: Query Insights dialog → Subtitle: lowercase fallback filling the {database} slot when the connection has no default database selected (non–SQL Server engines); refers to whichever database the session is using.

dialog_title.location: Query Insights dialog → Title bar: title bar of the dialog (and of its popped-out window) listing the most expensive or most frequent queries recorded by the server; opened from the Tools menu, Object Explorer, or Command Palette.

disabled_clickhouse.value: Die Abfrageprotokollierung ist für diesen Benutzer deaktiviert (log_queries = 0) oder system.query_log wurde noch nicht erstellt, daher hat ClickHouse keinen Abfrageverlauf zum Anzeigen. Setzen Sie log_queries = 1 in users.xml oder im Einstellungsprofil des Benutzers, führen Sie eine Abfrage aus und dann SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS.
disabled_clickhouse.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: explanation shown on ClickHouse connections when query logging is off or the system query_log table does not exist yet; keep setting names and SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS untranslated.

disabled_mysql.value: Performance Schema ist auf diesem Server deaktiviert. Aktivieren Sie es in der Serverkonfiguration und starten Sie MySQL/MariaDB neu, bevor Query Insights Abfrage-Digests lesen kann.
disabled_mysql.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: explanation shown on MySQL/MariaDB connections when Performance Schema is turned off on the server, so no statement statistics can be read.

disabled_oracle.value: Der gemeinsam genutzte Pool enthält noch keine ausgeführten Cursor, daher gibt es keine Anweisungsstatistiken anzuzeigen.
disabled_oracle.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: explanation shown on Oracle connections when the shared pool (V$SQLAREA) contains no executed statements yet, so there are no statistics to list.

disabled_postgres.value: pg_stat_statements ist in dieser Datenbank nicht installiert, daher hat PostgreSQL hier keine kumulativen Anweisungsstatistiken zu zeigen.
disabled_postgres.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: explanation shown on PostgreSQL connections when the pg_stat_statements extension is not installed in the database; the button below can script its CREATE EXTENSION statement.

disabled_sqlserver.value: Der Abfrage-Store ist für [{database}] deaktiviert, daher gibt es keine erfasste Abfragehistorie anzuzeigen.
disabled_sqlserver.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: explanation shown on SQL Server when Query Store is turned off for the database; {database} is the database name in square brackets. A button below scripts the enable statement.

empty.value: {source} ist verfügbar, hat jedoch noch keine Abfragen erfasst.
empty.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: dim message shown when the statistics source is enabled but returned no rows; {source} is the source name, e.g. “PostgreSQL pg_stat_statements”.

failures_footer.value: Die neuesten {limit} fehlgeschlagenen Abfragen von {source} ({window}) · wählen Sie eine Zeile aus und klicken Sie auf "Ausgewählte Abfrage öffnen", um sie in einem Tab zu bearbeiten
failures_footer.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer caption (ClickHouse, failures view): describes the list; {limit} is the row cap (50), {source} the source name, {window} the lowercase time window, e.g. “last hour”. Names the Open Selected Query button.

guidance_clickhouse.value: ClickHouse-Einblicke lesen system.query_log, wofür log_queries = 1 für den verbundenen Benutzer (users.xml oder ein Einstellungsprofil), die query_log-Tabelle aktiviert in config.xml und die Berechtigung zum Lesen der Systemdatenbank erforderlich sind. Der Server schreibt das Log alle paar Sekunden; führen Sie SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS aus, um die neuesten Abfragen sofort zu sehen.
guidance_clickhouse.location: Query Insights dialog → Error message: second paragraph appended after the error when the ClickHouse query log could not be read; explains the server settings and permissions required. Keep setting names untranslated.

guidance_mysql.value: MySQL/MariaDB-Einblicke erfordern Performance Schema Statement-Digest-Consumer und die Berechtigung zum Lesen von performance_schema; die Aktivierung des Performance Schema kann Serverkonfiguration und einen Neustart erfordern.
guidance_mysql.location: Query Insights dialog → Error message: second paragraph appended after the error when MySQL/MariaDB statement digests could not be read; explains the Performance Schema setup and permissions needed.

guidance_oracle.value: Oracle-Einblicke lesen den Shared Pool über V$SQLAREA; fragen Sie einen DBA nach SELECT auf V_$SQLAREA (oder SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE) für dieses Login.
guidance_oracle.location: Query Insights dialog → Error message: second paragraph appended after the error when Oracle’s V$SQLAREA could not be read; tells the user which grant to request from a DBA. Keep view and role names untranslated.

guidance_postgres.value: PostgreSQL-Einblicke erfordern die pg_stat_statements-Erweiterung und die Berechtigung zum Lesen ihrer Ansicht; die Einrichtung der Erweiterung kann shared_preload_libraries und einen Neustart erfordern.
guidance_postgres.location: Query Insights dialog → Error message: second paragraph appended after the error when pg_stat_statements could not be read; explains the extension and permission requirements. Keep identifiers untranslated.

guidance_sqlserver.value: SQL Server Query Store erfordert SQL Server 2016+ oder Azure SQL und VIEW DATABASE STATE auf [{database}].
guidance_sqlserver.location: Query Insights dialog → Error message: second paragraph appended after the error when SQL Server Query Store could not be read; states the version and permission required. {database} is the database name in brackets.

loading.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: dim progress message shown while the ranked query list is being fetched, after the source was confirmed enabled and after changing rank or time window.

manual_setup_required.value: Dieser Collector muss in der Serverkonfiguration aktiviert sein; es gibt keine sichere SQL-Einrichtungsanweisung zum Skripten.
manual_setup_required.location: Query Insights dialog → Status bar (manual setup message): status-bar message shown if the user asks to script the enable statement for a collector (MySQL, ClickHouse, Oracle) that can only be turned on in server configuration files.

no_supported_collector.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: fallback message in the “source is off” state when the connection’s engine has no statistics collector at all; rarely seen.

open_selected_button.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer: primary button that opens the SQL text of the selected grid row in a new query tab and closes the dialog. Title-case command label.

rank_avg_buffer_accesses.location: Query Insights dialog → Rank button / footer caption: name of the third ranking metric on PostgreSQL (average shared-buffer hits plus reads per execution); also used lowercase inside the caption.

rank_avg_buffer_gets.location: Query Insights dialog → Rank button / footer caption: name of the third ranking metric on Oracle (average buffer gets per execution); also used lowercase inside the caption.

rank_avg_duration.location: Query Insights dialog → Rank button / footer caption: name of the default ranking metric, average elapsed time per execution; shown after “Rank:” and lowercase in the caption.

rank_avg_logical_reads.location: Query Insights dialog → Rank button / footer caption: name of the third ranking metric on SQL Server (average logical page reads per execution); also used lowercase inside the caption.

rank_avg_rows_examined.location: Query Insights dialog → Rank button / footer caption: name of the third ranking metric on MySQL/MariaDB (average rows examined per execution); also used lowercase inside the caption.

rank_avg_rows_read.location: Query Insights dialog → Rank button / footer caption: name of the third ranking metric on ClickHouse (average rows read per query); also used lowercase inside the caption.

rank_button.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer buttons: button that cycles the ranking metric (average duration → executions → reads) and reloads the list; {rank} is the current metric name. Disabled in the failures view.

rank_executions.location: Query Insights dialog → Rank button / footer caption: name of the ranking metric that orders queries by how many times they ran; shown after “Rank:” and lowercase in the caption.

refresh_button.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer buttons: button that re-checks whether the statistics source is enabled and reloads the query list; disabled while loading.

script_enable_button.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: button under the “source is off” explanation (SQL Server and PostgreSQL only) that writes the statement enabling Query Store or pg_stat_statements into a new query tab.

selection_required.value: Wählen Sie zuerst eine Zeile im Raster aus
selection_required.location: Query Insights dialog → Status bar (selection hint): status-bar hint shown when the user clicks Open Selected Query without first selecting a row in the dialog’s result grid.

showing_failures_button.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer buttons (ClickHouse only): toggle button label while the dialog lists recently failed queries; clicking switches back to the top-queries view.

showing_top_button.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer buttons (ClickHouse only): toggle button label while the dialog lists the top-ranked queries; clicking switches to recently failed queries.

subtitle.location: Query Insights dialog → Subtitle line: dim subtitle line above the results area; {source} is the statistics source name, e.g. “MySQL Performance Schema”, and {database} the database name in square brackets.

top_queries_footer.value: Top {limit} Abfragen von {source} nach {rank} ({window}) · Wählen Sie eine Zeile aus und Öffnen Sie die ausgewählte Abfrage, um sie in einem Tab zu bearbeiten
top_queries_footer.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer caption (top-queries view): {limit} is the row cap (50), {source} the source name, {rank} the lowercase metric, {window} the lowercase time window or “cumulative statistics”. Names the Open Selected Query button.

unavailable.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: red error shown when the statistics source cannot be queried; {source} is the source name, {error} the server error, and after a blank line {guidance} the engine-specific setup advice.

unsupported_collector.value: Diese Engine verfügt über keine unterstützte Quelle für kumulative Abfrage-Statistiken.
unsupported_collector.location: Query Insights dialog → Results area: error text filling the {error} slot when the connected engine (e.g. SQLite) has no supported query-statistics source or no query could be built for it.

unsupported_engine.location: Query Insights dialog → Statistics source name fallback: fallback source name used in the subtitle, footer, and messages when the connected engine has no statistics source; fills the {source} slot, so keep it a short noun phrase.

unsupported_guidance.value: Query Insights unterstützt SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB und Oracle Database.
unsupported_guidance.location: Query Insights dialog → Error message: second paragraph shown after the error on engines Query Insights does not support; lists the supported database engines.

window_all_time.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer buttons: time-window button label (default) meaning every captured execution is included; clicking cycles to the next window. Also lowercase in the caption. SQL Server and ClickHouse only.

window_last_day.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer buttons: time-window button label limiting statistics to the last 24 hours; clicking cycles to the next window. Also lowercase in the caption. Keep it short.

window_last_hour.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer buttons: time-window button label limiting statistics to the last hour; clicking cycles to the next window. Also lowercase in the caption.

window_last_week.location: Query Insights dialog → Footer buttons: time-window button label limiting statistics to the last 7 days; clicking cycles back to “All time”. Also lowercase in the caption.

bad_magic.location: Query tab → Version history → Stored results: diagnostic error (logged, not normally shown) when a saved result snapshot file does not start with the expected format signature, i.e. it is corrupt or not a snapshot.

invalid_utf8.location: Query tab → Version history → Stored results: diagnostic error (logged, not normally shown) when a text value inside a saved result snapshot is not valid UTF-8 encoded text.

kind_edit.location: Query tab → Version History panel → Version list: lowercase tag beside a version’s time showing it was saved after a pause in editing (as opposed to a run). Single short word.

kind_run.location: Query tab → Version History panel → Version list: lowercase tag beside a version’s time showing it was saved when the query was executed (as opposed to an edit). Single short word.

payload_truncated.location: Query tab → Version history → Stored results: diagnostic error (logged, not normally shown) when a saved result snapshot file ends before all its data could be read.

unknown_cell_tag.location: Query tab → Version history → Stored results: diagnostic error (logged, not normally shown) when a saved result snapshot holds a cell of an unknown type; {tag} is the numeric type code found.

unsupported_payload.location: Query tab → Version history → Stored results: diagnostic error (logged, not normally shown) when a saved result snapshot was written in a newer or unknown format version.

column_type_summary.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim text beside each column name; {data_type} is the column’s SQL type and {nullability} the word “null” or “not null”.

column_validation_failed.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog: red inline error under the column list when a column set to Constant has a value that fails type validation; {column_name} is the column. Code also supplies a {reason} placeholder.

count_label.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Top row: label before the input for how many rows to generate and stage (1 to 1000).

count_out_of_range.value: Die Anzahl muss zwischen {minimum} und {maximum} liegen
count_out_of_range.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog: red inline error when the Count input is outside the allowed range; {minimum} and {maximum} are the limits (1 and 1000). Disables the Stage button.

dialog_title.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog: title bar of the dialog opened from the grid row menu’s Batch Insert command; the code passes {table_name}, the quoted target table name.

generator_binary.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: random binary bytes.

generator_boolean.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: true/false values.

generator_date.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: calendar dates without time.

generator_datetime.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: combined date and time values.

generator_decimal.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: numbers with decimal places.

generator_email.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: fake email addresses.

generator_guid.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: GUID/UUID identifiers.

generator_integer.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: whole numbers.

generator_json.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: small JSON documents.

generator_name.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: fake person names.

generator_text.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: sentences of filler text.

generator_time.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: times of day without a date.

generator_word.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: dim label shown beside a column whose source is Generated, naming the random-value kind: single random words.

not_null_summary.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: lowercase word filling {nullability} in the column type summary when the column does not accept NULL.

null_not_allowed.value: Spalte {column_name} darf nicht NULL sein (Spalte ist NICHT NULL)
null_not_allowed.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog: red inline error when a column that does not accept NULL has its source set to NULL; {column_name} is that column. Disables the Stage button.

nullable_summary.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: lowercase word filling {nullability} in the column type summary when the column accepts NULL.

preview_truncation.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → SQL preview box: shown when the preview script exceeds 20 lines; {preview} is the first 20 lines, then on a new line an ellipsis note where {hidden_line_count} is the number of hidden lines.

seed_label.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Top row: label before the random seed number input; the same seed always produces the same generated values.

seed_placeholder.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Top row: lowercase placeholder in the empty random-seed input beside the Seed label.

source_constant.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column source dropdown: option that writes the same literal value, typed in an input beside it, into every generated row.

source_default.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column source dropdown: option that leaves the column out of the INSERT so the database applies its default value.

source_generated.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column source dropdown: option that fills each row with a random test value of a kind inferred from the column type.

source_null.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column source dropdown: option that writes NULL into the column for every row; SQL keyword, usually left untranslated.

source_sequence.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column source dropdown: option that fills the column with increasing numbers from a start value by a step, set in two inputs beside it.

source_skip.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column source dropdown: option that never writes the column; the default for identity, computed, and row-version columns.

stage_button.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog: primary button that adds the generated rows to the grid’s pending (unsaved) changes; {row_count} is the Count value.

step_placeholder.location: Results → Batch Insert dialog → Column list: lowercase placeholder in the second input shown for a Sequence column, the amount added for each next row.

maintenance_failed_for_all.value: Die Wartung konnte an keinem ausgewählten Objekt durchgeführt werden: {object_errors}
maintenance_failed_for_all.location: Object Explorer → Multi-selection banner → Maintenance: status-bar error when no selected object yielded a maintenance statement; {object_errors} lists each skipped object and its reason, separated by semicolons.

maintenance_review_header.value: Massenwartung an {table_count} Tabelle(n) — bitte vor Ausführung sorgfältig überprüfen.
maintenance_review_header.location: Object Explorer → Multi-selection banner → Maintenance: SQL comment on the first line of the generated script in a new query tab; {table_count} is the number of tables. Warns to review before running.

no_maintenance_selection.value: Es wurde nichts zum Ausführen der Wartung ausgewählt
no_maintenance_selection.location: Object Explorer → Multi-selection banner → Maintenance: status-bar error when the bulk maintenance action ran with no objects that could be processed.

object_maintenance_error.location: Object Explorer → Multi-selection banner → Maintenance: entry in the skipped-objects list when one table’s maintenance statement could not be built; {object_name} is schema.table, {error} the reason.

object_type_table.location: Object Explorer → Multi-selection banner → Maintenance: object-kind word for a table, placed in parentheses after a skipped object’s name in the skipped-objects list.

object_type_view.location: Object Explorer → Multi-selection banner → Maintenance: object-kind word for a view, placed in parentheses after a view’s name in the skipped list, since maintenance runs on tables only.

unsupported_object_kind.location: Object Explorer → Multi-selection banner → Maintenance: entry in the skipped-objects list for a selected object that is not a table; {object_name} is schema.name and {object_kind} its kind, e.g. View.

invalid_key.location: Query tab → Cached last results: diagnostic error (logged, not normally shown) when restoring or saving a tab’s cached results is given an identifier that is not a valid tab key.

store_busy.location: Query tab → Cached last results: diagnostic error (logged, not normally shown) when the per-tab result cache cannot be locked to save or load a tab’s last results.

row_count.location: Results → Canvas layout: dim row count in parentheses on each result tile’s header strip, after the result set name; {row_count} is the number of rows in that result set.

binary_file_too_large.value: Datei ist {file_mib} MiB; das Limit ist {limit_mib} MiB.
binary_file_too_large.location: Results → Row Editor and grid cell menu → Load from file: error shown when the chosen file is too large to load into a binary cell; {file_mib} is its size and {limit_mib} the limit, both in MiB.

current_user_function.location: Results → Row Editor → Field Insert menu: name of the SQL function that writes the server’s current login name; also shown in angle brackets as the staged field value.

default_function.location: Results → Row Editor: name for the column-default expression; reserved, since staged defaults currently display the SQL keyword DEFAULT instead.

expression_marker.location: Results → Row Editor → Field value: placeholder shown in a field staged to receive a server-evaluated value; {expression_name} is the function name, e.g. “Server date”, wrapped in angle brackets.

relay_sql_functions_reason.value: Serverdatum, Server-UUID und aktueller Benutzer benötigen eine neuere SQLLY-Bridge: die Bridge auf dieser Relay-Verbindung ist eine ältere Version, die diese ablehnt. Aktualisieren Sie die Bridge oder verwenden Sie stattdessen Neue UUID oder den lokalen Uhrzeitstempel.
relay_sql_functions_reason.location: Results → Row Editor and grid cell menu: tooltip, banner, or status-bar explanation of why server date, server UUID, and current-user functions are disabled on a relay connection whose bridge is too old.

relay_staged_save_reason.value: Das Speichern von gestagten Änderungen erfordert eine neuere SQLLY-Brücke: Die Brücke in dieser Relay-Verbindung ist eine ältere Version, die kein Batch committen kann. Aktualisieren Sie die Brücke oder bearbeiten Sie die Zeilen einzeln im Zeileneditor.
relay_staged_save_reason.location: Results → Staged changes bar: tooltip on the disabled Save button, and status-bar error, explaining that staged edits cannot be saved over a relay connection whose bridge is too old.

server_date_function.location: Results → Row Editor → Field Insert menu: name of the SQL function that writes the server’s current date/time into a date column; also shown in angle brackets as the staged value.

server_time_function.location: Results → Row Editor → Field value: name of the server’s current time function, shown in angle brackets in a date or time field staged to receive the server time.

server_uuid_function.location: Results → Row Editor → Field Insert menu: name of the SQL function that has the server generate a new UUID for the column; also shown in angle brackets as the staged value.

sql_function_menu_label.location: Results → Row Editor → Field Insert menu: menu item for a server-evaluated function; {function_name} is its friendly name, e.g. “Server UUID”, and {sql_expression} the engine’s SQL, e.g. NEWID().

value_copied.location: Results → Grid: short success toast shown after double-clicking a data cell in the Grid tab, which copies that cell’s value to the clipboard.

apply_edit_button.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer while editing: primary button that stages the edited value as a pending grid change (saved later with Save).

bottom_divider_label.location: Results → Cell Details panel docked at the bottom: label on the horizontal splitter strip above the panel, visible when the panel is collapsed; clicking it expands the panel.

byte_count.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value and Row views: text shown in place of a binary cell value; {byte_count} is the number of bytes, wrapped in angle brackets.

cancel_edit_button.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer while editing: button that discards the draft and closes the editor without staging anything.

close_button.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Header: small button at the far right that closes the docked panel.

edit_button.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer: small button that opens a multi-line editor on the shown cell's value; shown only when the result can be edited.

edit_hint.value: {apply_shortcut} zum Anwenden · Esc zum Rückgängig machen
edit_hint.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer while editing: dim hint between the buttons; {apply_shortcut} is the platform chord such as Cmd+Enter or Ctrl+Enter.

empty_string_placeholder.location: Results → Cell Details panel → value editor: placeholder shown when the editor is empty, making clear that applying stages an empty string, not NULL.

empty_title.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Header: panel title shown when no grid cell is selected; once a cell is selected it is replaced by the column name and type.

full_value_unavailable.value: Der vollständige Wert konnte nicht geladen werden, daher kann diese verkürzte Vorschau nicht bearbeitet werden.
full_value_unavailable.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer: reason shown after “Read-only:” when fetching the complete value of a long cell failed.

invalid_json_warning.value: Gestaged, aber dies ist kein gültiges JSON: {error}
invalid_json_warning.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer: non-blocking warning after applying text to a JSON column that does not parse; {error} is the parser's message. The edit is still staged.

loading_full_value.value: Lade den vollständigen Wert — Sie können ihn bearbeiten, sobald er angekommen ist.
loading_full_value.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer: dim note while a long value shown as a shortened preview is being fetched in full; editing is disabled until then.

open_window_button.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Header: small button that opens the current cell value in a separate, larger viewer dialog.

pin_button.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Header: small toggle button that pins the panel to the current cell so it stops following later grid selections.

read_only_binary.value: Binärwerte werden mit 'Von Datei laden' oder dem Hex-Viewer geändert, nicht als Text.
read_only_binary.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer: reason (after “Read-only:”) shown for a binary cell; also shown in the status bar if text is applied to a binary column.

read_only_computed.value: Dies ist eine berechnete Spalte, die anhand einer Formel ermittelt wird, nicht eine in der Tabelle gespeicherte Spalte.
read_only_computed.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer: reason (after “Read-only:”) shown for a grid column added with a formula (a computed column).

read_only_masked.value: Diese Spalte ist maskiert; zeigen Sie sie an, um den Wert zu bearbeiten.
read_only_masked.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer: reason (after “Read-only:”) shown when the column's values are hidden by a masking rule.

read_only_reason.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer: dim note explaining why the shown value cannot be edited; {reason} is a full sentence such as “This column is masked; reveal it to edit the value.”

read_only_staged_expression.value: Diese Zelle hat einen gestagten Ausdruck (wie DEFAULT); setzen Sie die Zeile zurück, um stattdessen einen Wert einzugeben.
read_only_staged_expression.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer: reason (after “Read-only:”) shown when the cell already has a staged SQL expression such as DEFAULT or the server time.

read_only_staged_insert.value: Dies ist eine neue, ungespeicherte Zeile; setzen Sie sie zurück und staggen Sie sie erneut, um ihre Werte zu ändern.
read_only_staged_insert.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer: reason (after “Read-only:”) shown for a cell of a row that is staged for insertion but not yet saved.

right_divider_label.location: Results → Cell Details panel docked on the right: label on the vertical splitter strip, drawn one letter per line when collapsed; keep it a single short word.

row_position.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Header: dim second line under the column name; {row_number} is the selected row’s position and {total_rows} the number of rows in the result.

row_tab.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Header: second segment of the Value/Row switch, showing every column of the selected row as a read-only name/value list.

select_cell_empty_state.value: Wählen Sie eine Zelle in einem Ergebnisraster aus
select_cell_empty_state.location: Results → Cell Details panel: centered empty-state hint shown in the panel body until the user selects a cell in a results grid.

set_null_button.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Value view footer while editing: button that stages SQL NULL for the cell (an empty editor stages an empty string instead). Keep NULL untranslated.

switch_dock_side_button.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Header: small button that moves the panel between docking on the right of the grid and below it.

unpin_button.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Header: label of the pin toggle while pinned; clicking releases the panel so it follows the grid selection again.

value_tab.location: Results → Cell Details panel → Header: first segment of the Value/Row switch, showing the selected cell’s full value with a structured viewer.

missing_key_columns.value: Der vollständige Wert ist nicht verfügbar — führen Sie die Abfrage erneut mit der ausgewählten Schlüsselspalte(n) der Tabelle aus, damit sie über den Schlüssel abgerufen werden kann.
missing_key_columns.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when you try to open, copy, or dock the full value of a truncated large cell but the result has no table key columns, so SQLLY cannot re-fetch the complete value from the database.

size_bytes.location: Results → Large cell values: byte-size unit used in cell-size messages (truncation banner, viewer-limit message, “Copied full value” status) for values under 1 KiB; {size} is a whole number of bytes. Keep the unit abbreviation short.

size_gib.location: Results → Large cell values: gibibyte-size unit used in cell-size messages (truncation banner, viewer-limit message, “Copied full value” status) for values of 1 GiB or more; {size} has one decimal. Keep the abbreviation short.

size_kib.location: Results → Large cell values: kibibyte-size unit used in cell-size messages (truncation banner, viewer-limit message, “Copied full value” status) for values from 1 KiB to under 1 MiB; {size} has one decimal. Keep the abbreviation short.

size_mib.location: Results → Large cell values: mebibyte-size unit used in cell-size messages (truncation banner, viewer-limit message, “Copied full value” status) for values from 1 MiB to under 1 GiB; {size} has one decimal. Keep the abbreviation short.

unavailable_truncation.value: — gekürzt: die ersten {shown_size} von {total_size} werden angezeigt —
unavailable_truncation.location: Results → Cell value viewer / Cell details → Value tab: banner line shown under the partial preview when the full value of a truncated cell cannot be loaded; {shown_size} is the preview size, {total_size} the full value size. Dashes frame it as a separator line.

viewer_limit_exceeded.value: Dieser Wert ist {value_size}, über dem {limit_size} Viewer-Limit. Exportieren Sie stattdessen die Spalte in eine Datei.
viewer_limit_exceeded.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when you try to open a truncated cell whose full value is larger than the cell viewer’s hard size limit; {value_size} is the value’s size, and the second number is meant to be the viewer limit. Suggests exporting the column instead.

lowercase.location: Results → Cell editing → Transform: menu entry naming a text macro, listed in the Transform dropdown of the Row editor and Staged changes bar and as “Transform: …” in the grid cell context menu; converts the text to all small letters. Written in lowercase to show its effect.

remove_diacritics.location: Results → Cell editing → Transform: menu entry naming a text macro, listed in the Transform dropdown of the Row editor and Staged changes bar and as “Transform: …” in the grid cell context menu; strips accents and other diacritical marks from letters (é becomes e).

title_case.location: Results → Cell editing → Transform: menu entry naming a text macro, listed in the Transform dropdown of the Row editor and Staged changes bar and as “Transform: …” in the grid cell context menu; capitalizes the first letter of each word. Written in title case to show its effect.

trim_whitespace.location: Results → Cell editing → Transform: menu entry naming a text macro, listed in the Transform dropdown of the Row editor and Staged changes bar and as “Transform: …” in the grid cell context menu; removes leading and trailing spaces, tabs, and line breaks from the value.

uppercase.location: Results → Cell editing → Transform: menu entry naming a text macro, listed in the Transform dropdown of the Row editor and Staged changes bar and as “Transform: …” in the grid cell context menu; converts the text to all capital letters. Written in capitals to show its effect.

column_index_not_allowed.value: Diagrammhinweis ignoriert: {field_role} muss eine Ergebnisspalte benennen, darf keinen Spaltenindex verwenden.
column_index_not_allowed.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Chart hint: warning on a “-- sqlly chart:” comment line (shown before the expected-syntax reminder) when the label or values field gives a column number or blank instead of a column name; {field_role} is the field name (label or values).

invalid_aggregate.value: Diagrammhinweis ignoriert: Aggregat "{aggregate}" ist nicht eines von none, sum, average, minimum, maximum oder count.
invalid_aggregate.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Chart hint: warning on a “-- sqlly chart:” comment line (shown before the expected-syntax reminder) when the aggregate field has an unrecognized value; {aggregate} is the user’s text. The listed option words are literal syntax and must stay in English.

invalid_kind.value: Diagrammhinweis ignoriert: Typ "{kind}" ist nicht einer von bar, line, area, scatter, histogram, pie oder donut.
invalid_kind.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Chart hint: warning on a “-- sqlly chart:” comment line (shown before the expected-syntax reminder) when the kind field names an unknown chart type; {kind} is the user’s text. The listed chart-kind words are literal syntax and must stay in English.

invalid_navigate.value: Diagrammhinweis ignoriert: navigate muss true oder false sein, nicht "{value}".
invalid_navigate.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Chart hint: warning on a “-- sqlly chart:” comment line (shown before the expected-syntax reminder) when the navigate field (whether clicking a chart element jumps to its rows) is not true or false; {value} is the user’s text. Keep true/false and navigate in English.

invalid_order.value: Diagrammhinweis ignoriert: Reihenfolge "{order}" ist nicht eine von source, category oder value.
invalid_order.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Chart hint: warning on a “-- sqlly chart:” comment line (shown before the expected-syntax reminder) when the order field (category sort order) has an unrecognized value; {order} is the user’s text. The option words are literal syntax and stay in English.

invalid_result_number.value: Diagrammhinweis ignoriert: Ergebnis muss eine Ergebnismenge mit der Nummer 1 sein, nicht "{value}".
invalid_result_number.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Chart hint: warning on a “-- sqlly chart:” comment line (shown before the expected-syntax reminder) when the result field (which result set to chart, counting from 1) is not a positive number; {value} is the user’s text. Keep the word result in English.

invalid_top_count.value: Diagrammhinweis ignoriert: top muss eine positive ganze Zahl sein, nicht "{value}".
invalid_top_count.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Chart hint: warning on a “-- sqlly chart:” comment line (shown before the expected-syntax reminder) when the top field (show only the N largest categories) is not a positive whole number; {value} is the user’s text. Keep the word top in English.

kind_required.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Chart hint: warning on a “-- sqlly chart:” comment line (shown before the expected-syntax reminder) when the hint has no kind field, which is the only required field (chart type). Keep the word kind in English.

malformed_field.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Chart hint: warning on a “-- sqlly chart:” comment line (shown before the expected-syntax reminder) when a semicolon-separated part has no colon; {field} is that part as typed. “key:value” describes the required syntax.

missing_column.value: Diagramm-Hinweis ignoriert: {field_role} Spalte "{column_name}" wurde im Ergebnissatz nicht gefunden.
missing_column.location: Results → Chart tab: warning when a chart hint names a column that is not in the returned result set; {field_role} is the field (label or values), {column_name} the missing name. The hint is then ignored.

multiple_hints.value: Diagramm-Hinweis: mehrere -- sqlly chart: Hinweise gefunden; letzter gültiger Hinweis wird verwendet.
multiple_hints.location: SQL editor → Query comment hints: warning when a query contains more than one valid “-- sqlly chart:” comment; only the last valid one is used. “-- sqlly chart:” is literal syntax and stays untranslated.

unknown_field.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Chart hint: warning on a “-- sqlly chart:” comment line (shown before the expected-syntax reminder) when a field name is not one of the known chart fields (kind, label, values, aggregate, order, top, navigate, result); {field_name} is the unknown name.

view_without_hint.value: Diagrammansicht angefordert, aber kein -- sqlly chart: Hinweis gefunden.
view_without_hint.location: SQL editor → Query comment hints: warning when “-- sqlly view: chart” asks to open results on the Chart tab but the query has no valid “-- sqlly chart:” hint. Directive text stays untranslated.

empty_state.value: Noch keine gespeicherten Diagramme — öffnen Sie die Diagramm-Registerkarte in einem Ergebnissatz und wählen Sie Diagramm in Bibliothek speichern…, kehren Sie dann hierher zurück.
empty_state.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Tile grid: empty-state message shown when the saved-chart library has no charts; explains how to save one from a result set’s Chart tab. “Chart” and “Save chart to library…” name existing UI labels.

missing_connection.value: Die Verbindung dieses Diagramms existiert nicht mehr. Bearbeiten Sie das SQL des Diagramms in einem neuen Tab oder löschen Sie es aus Gespeicherte Diagramme.
missing_connection.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Chart tile: error text shown inside a tile whose saved connection profile has been deleted, so the chart cannot run; suggests editing its SQL or deleting it from Saved Charts.

no_result_set.value: Die Abfrage lieferte kein Ergebnis, das dargestellt werden kann.
no_result_set.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Chart tile: error text shown inside a tile when its query finished but returned no result set with columns to plot.

not_select.value: Nur schreibgeschützte SELECT-Abfragen werden auf dem Dashboard ausgeführt. Öffnen Sie das Diagramm aus Gespeicherten Diagrammen, um es in einem Abfrage-Tab auszuführen.
not_select.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) and Server dashboard → Tile: error text shown inside a tile whose saved SQL is not a read-only SELECT, so the dashboard refuses to run it; the chart can still be opened and run in a query tab.

read_only_summary.value: {chart_count} gespeicherte Diagramme · schreibgeschützt: Kacheln führen nur SELECT-Abfragen aus
read_only_summary.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Footer: small summary line under the tile grid; {chart_count} is the number of saved charts shown, followed by a note that tiles only run read-only SELECT queries.

refresh_all_button.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Header buttons: button that re-runs the query of every chart tile at once; disabled while any tile is loading or when there are no charts.

reload_library_button.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Header buttons: secondary button that re-reads the saved-chart library so newly saved, renamed, or deleted charts appear as tiles.

tile_loading.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Chart tile body: placeholder centered in a tile while its query is running and no chart has been drawn yet.

tile_no_data.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Chart tile body: placeholder centered in a tile that has not run its query yet and has no chart to draw.

tile_not_refreshed.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Chart tile header: status in the tile’s caption line (between the connection/database and the refresh interval) when the chart has never been refreshed in this session.

tile_refresh_button.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Chart tile header: small button on each tile that re-runs only that chart’s query; disabled while loading or when the chart cannot run.

tile_refreshed.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Chart tile header: status in the tile’s caption line telling when the chart last finished refreshing; {relative_age} is a short age such as “just now” or “5 min ago”.

tile_refreshing.location: Chart Dashboard (Tools menu → Chart dashboard) → Chart tile header: status in the tile’s caption line while the chart’s query is running.

title.location: Chart Dashboard dialog → Header title: title in the header of the in-app dialog (opened from Tools → Chart dashboard) that shows every saved chart as a live, auto-refreshing tile.

window_title.location: Chart Dashboard → Pop-out window: operating-system window title used after the dashboard is detached from the main window into its own standalone window.

area_description.value: Kumulierte oder gestapelte Änderung über eine geordnete Achse anzeigen
area_description.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: description of a chart-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it picks the chart type for a result — area chart, showing cumulative or stacked change over an ordered axis.

bar_description.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: description of a chart-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it picks the chart type for a result — bar chart, comparing amounts across categories.

column_type_description.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: description attached to each column option when the AI decision model chooses the label column; {data_type} is the column’s database type name.

donut_description.value: Den Anteil jeder Kategorie an einer einzigen Gesamtmenge anzeigen, mit offenem Zentrum
donut_description.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: description of a chart-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it picks the chart type for a result — donut chart, a pie chart with a hollow center.

histogram_description.value: Die Verteilung einer numerischen Spalte anzeigen
histogram_description.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: description of a chart-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it picks the chart type for a result — histogram, showing how one numeric column’s values are distributed.

kind_question.value: Welche Diagramm-Darstellung passt am besten zu diesem Ergebnis?
kind_question.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: question sent to the optional AI decision model asking which chart type best fits the current result’s columns.

label_question.value: Welche Spalte benennt am besten jeden Balken, Punkt oder jeden Abschnitt eines Diagramms dieses Ergebnisses?
label_question.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: question sent to the optional AI decision model asking which column should name the categories (bars, points, or slices).

line_description.value: Zeigen, wie sich Werte über eine geordnete Achse wie Zeit verändern
line_description.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: description of a chart-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it picks the chart type for a result — line chart, showing change over an ordered axis such as time.

measure_question.value: Spalte {column_name} ist eine zu plottende Messgröße (ein Betrag, eine Anzahl oder eine Rate).
measure_question.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: statement the AI decision model rates as likely or unlikely for each numeric column, deciding whether to plot it as a series; {column_name} is the column.

pie_description.value: Zeigen Sie den Anteil jeder Kategorie an einem einzelnen Gesamtwert
pie_description.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: description of a chart-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it picks the chart type for a result — pie chart, showing each category’s share of one total.

scatter_description.value: Zeigen Sie die Beziehung zwischen einzelnen Messungen
scatter_description.location: Results → Chart tab → Suggested chart (AI): not shown on screen: description of a chart-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it picks the chart type for a result — scatter plot, showing how individual measurements relate.

client_display_label.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): row label for how long SQLLY took to render the results on screen after the query finished; shown only when measured.

client_display_note.value: Zeit bis zur Darstellung der Ergebnisse nach Abschluss
client_display_note.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): dim note after the Client display time value, defining it as rendering time after the query completed. Lowercase sentence fragment.

first_response_label.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): row label for the delay between sending the query and receiving the first row or message; shown only when measured.

first_response_note.value: Versand bis die erste Zeile/Nachricht angekommen ist
first_response_note.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): dim note after the Time to first response value, defining it as dispatch until the first row or message arrived. Lowercase sentence fragment.

last_run_caption.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): dim caption at the top of the tab, above the metric rows, explaining that the figures describe the most recent query run.

result_sets_label.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): row label for the number of result sets the last run returned.

rows_affected_label.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): row label for the number of rows inserted, updated, or deleted by the last run; shown only when the server reported it.

rows_affected_note.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): dim note after the Rows affected value, clarifying the count comes from the database server. Lowercase sentence fragment.

rows_returned_label.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): row label for the total number of rows the last run returned.

rows_returned_note.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): dim note after the Rows returned value, clarifying the count adds up rows of every result set. Lowercase sentence fragment.

server_time_label.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): row label for how long the database engine spent executing the last query; shown only when measured.

server_time_note.value: Zeit, die die Engine für die Ausführung der Abfrage aufgewendet hat
server_time_note.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): dim note after the Server execution time value, explaining it is the engine’s own running time. Lowercase sentence fragment.

wall_clock_label.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): row label for the total elapsed time of the last run from start to finish; shown only when measured.

wall_clock_note.value: von Anfang bis Ende, einschließlich Anzeige
wall_clock_note.location: Results → Statistics tab (Client Statistics): dim note after the Total wall-clock time value, clarifying it covers the whole run end to end including display. Lowercase sentence fragment.

browser_encode_failed.location: Results → Messages tab → Column layout errors: error shown in the browser (web) edition when saved column widths, order, and visibility cannot be converted to text for storage; the underlying error may follow.

browser_load_failed.value: Spaltenlayouts konnten nicht geladen werden ({error}); sie wurden unverändert belassen
browser_load_failed.location: Results → Messages tab → Column layout errors: error in the browser (web) edition when the stored column-layout data cannot be read; {error} is the parse error. Saved layouts are left as they were and saving stops.

browser_save_failed.location: Results → Messages tab → Column layout errors: error shown in the browser (web) edition when saving column widths, order, and visibility to browser storage fails; the underlying error may follow.

empty_columns_hidden.location: Results → Messages tab: confirmation after choosing Hide empty columns in the grid’s column context menu; {hidden_count} is the number of columns hidden because every value in them was empty.

native_encode_failed.location: Results → Messages tab → Column layout errors: error shown in the desktop app when saved column widths, order, and visibility cannot be converted to file format before writing; the underlying error may follow.

native_load_failed.location: Results → Column Layout: error shown when the native column-layout store cannot be read or parsed; {error} is the underlying load failure.

native_save_failed.location: Results → Messages tab → Column layout errors: error shown in the desktop app when writing the column-layout file to disk fails; the underlying error may follow.

no_data_directory.value: Spaltenlayouts konnten nicht gespeichert werden: kein Datenverzeichnis
no_data_directory.location: Results → Messages tab → Column layout errors: error shown in the desktop app when column layouts cannot be saved because SQLLY cannot find its application data folder.

no_empty_columns.location: Results → Messages tab: notice after choosing Hide empty columns in the grid’s column context menu when no column was entirely empty, so nothing was hidden.

save_blocked.value: {error}. Spaltenlayoutänderungen werden nicht gespeichert; beheben Sie das Problem oder entfernen Sie die Datei, um sie erneut zu speichern.
save_blocked.location: Results → Messages tab → Column layout errors: one-time message when the existing column-layout file is unreadable; {error} is the load error. Explains that layout changes are no longer saved until the file is fixed or removed.

category_description.value: Ein kleiner fester Satz von Kategorien- oder Statuswerten
category_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — a small fixed set of category or status values.

coordinates_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — geographic latitude/longitude coordinates.

currency_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — monetary amounts.

email_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — email addresses.

foreign_key_description.value: Verweise auf Zeilen in einer anderen Tabelle
foreign_key_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — values that reference rows of another table, like a foreign key.

free_text_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — free-form prose or descriptions.

government_id_description.value: Von der Regierung ausgestellte Identifikationsnummern wie SSN oder Reisepassnummern
government_id_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — government ID numbers such as social security or passport numbers.

identifier_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — identifiers such as primary keys or codes.

ip_address_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — network IP addresses.

json_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — JSON or other structured documents.

other_description.value: Alles, was in keinen der aufgelisteten Typen passt
other_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — the catch-all “other” type, used when no listed type fits.

payment_card_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — credit or debit card numbers.

percentage_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — percentages or ratios.

person_name_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — people’s names.

phone_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — phone numbers.

postal_address_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — street or postal addresses.

secret_description.value: Passwörter, Tokens, API-Schlüssel oder andere Geheimnisse
secret_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — secrets such as passwords, tokens, or API keys.

timestamp_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — dates, times, or timestamps.

url_description.location: Results toolbar → Mask suggestions (AI column profiling): not shown on screen: description of a column-type option sent to the optional AI decision model when it classifies what each result column holds, to suggest masking personal data — web addresses (URLs).

count_distinct_caption.value: Zählen eindeutiger Werte in {column_name} — lese {row_count} Zeilen von der Festplatte…
count_distinct_caption.location: Results → Grid: background caption while counting distinct values in {column_name} and reading {row_count} rows from a spill file.

profile_caption.value: Profilierung in {column_name} — lese {row_count} Zeilen von der Festplatte…
profile_caption.location: Results → Grid: background caption while profiling {column_name} and reading {row_count} rows from a spill file.

expected_name_formula.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Computed column: lowercase reason inserted into “This computed column is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly column:” comment line, shown when there is no equals sign; reminds the required form “<Name> = <formula>” (placeholders in angle brackets stay as syntax).

invalid_option.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Computed column: lowercase reason inserted into “This computed column is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly column:” comment line, shown when a setting after the formula (separated by semicolons) has no equals sign; {option} is that setting as typed.

invalid_result_number.value: Ergebnis muss eine Zahl ab 1 sein, nicht „{value}“
invalid_result_number.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Computed column: lowercase reason inserted into “This computed column is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly column:” comment line, shown when the result= setting (which result set gets the column, counting from 1) is not a positive number; {value} is the typed value.

name_required.value: die Spalte benötigt einen Namen vor =
name_required.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Computed column: lowercase reason inserted into “This computed column is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly column:” comment line, shown when nothing is written before the equals sign, so the new column has no name.

unknown_option.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Computed column: lowercase reason inserted into “This computed column is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly column:” comment line, shown when a setting after the formula uses a name other than after or result; {option_name} is the unrecognized name.

condition_and_scale_conflict.value: when= kann nicht mit scale= oder bar= kombiniert werden
condition_and_scale_conflict.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Conditional formatting: lowercase reason inserted into “This conditional directive is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly conditional:” comment line, shown when a rule mixes a when= condition with a scale= color scale or bar= data bar, which cannot be combined.

invalid_between.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Conditional formatting: lowercase reason inserted into “This conditional directive is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly conditional:” comment line, shown when a when=between test lacks the “<a> and <b>” form; {value} is the typed test. Keep between, and, <a>, <b> as syntax.

invalid_color.location: Results → Conditional directive validation: validation error ““{value}” is not a #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA color”.

invalid_number.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Conditional formatting: lowercase reason inserted into “This conditional directive is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly conditional:” comment line, shown when a > , < or between test in when= compares against something that is not a number; {value} is the typed text.

invalid_scale.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Conditional formatting: lowercase reason inserted into “This conditional directive is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly conditional:” comment line, shown when scale= is not two colors joined by two dots (from..to); {value} is the typed value.

missing_column.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Conditional formatting: lowercase reason inserted into “This conditional directive is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly conditional:” comment line, shown when the rule has no column= setting naming the result column to format. Keep column=<name> as syntax.

missing_rule_kind.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Conditional formatting: lowercase reason inserted into “This conditional directive is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly conditional:” comment line, shown when the rule has none of when= (condition), scale= (color scale), or bar= (data bar). Keep the setting names as syntax.

missing_style.value: eine when=-Regel benötigt text=, fill= oder bold
missing_style.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Conditional formatting: lowercase reason inserted into “This conditional directive is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly conditional:” comment line, shown when a when= rule sets no text color, fill color, or bold, so it would change nothing.

setting_not_key_value.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Conditional formatting: lowercase reason inserted into “This conditional directive is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly conditional:” comment line, shown when a semicolon-separated part is neither bold nor key=value; {setting} is that part as typed.

unknown_condition.value: unbekannter Test „{value}“ (null, nicht null, > n, < n, between a and b, is <text>, contains <text>)
unknown_condition.location: Results → Conditional directive validation: text “unknown test “{value}” (null, not null, > n, < n, between a and b, is <text>, contains <text>)”.

unknown_setting.location: SQL editor → Directive diagnostics → Conditional formatting: lowercase reason inserted into “This conditional directive is ignored — …” on a “-- sqlly conditional:” comment line, shown when a setting name is not column, when, text, fill, scale, or bar; {setting} is the unrecognized name.

add_rule_button.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → New rule editor: small button below the rule fields that validates the chosen rule type, values and colors and adds the rule to the column's rule list.

and_label.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → New rule editor: row label for the second number field, shown only for the “Value between … and …” rule type; it reads as the “and” joining the lower and upper bound.

bar_color_label.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → New rule editor: row label beside the color picker for the bar fill, shown only when the “Data bar” rule type is selected.

bold_label.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → New rule editor: checkbox label that makes matching cells bold; shown for value-condition rule types (not color scale or data bar).

color_scale_summary.value: Farbverlauf über den Bereich der Spalte
color_scale_summary.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → Existing rules list: one-line summary of a saved color-scale rule, meaning cells are tinted from the low to the high color across the column's minimum–maximum values.

condition_between.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → Existing rules list: condition fragment inserted into “When value {condition} → …” for a between rule; {first_value} and {second_value} are the lower and upper numbers.

condition_greater_than.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → Existing rules list: condition fragment inserted into “When value {condition} → …” for a greater-than rule; {value} is the threshold number.

condition_is_not_null.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → Existing rules list: condition fragment inserted into “When value {condition} → …” for a rule that matches any cell that is not NULL; NULL is the SQL keyword, keep it untranslated.

condition_is_null.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → Existing rules list: condition fragment inserted into “When value {condition} → …” for a rule that matches NULL cells; NULL is the SQL keyword, keep it untranslated.

condition_less_than.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → Existing rules list: condition fragment inserted into “When value {condition} → …” for a less-than rule; {value} is the threshold number.

condition_text_contains.location: Results → Conditional Formatting dialog → Existing rules list: condition fragment inserted into “When value {condition} → …” for a text-contains rule; {text} is the substring the cell must contain.
